skills.name: Twin Fans: Ukifune
skills.description:
Hirara has only two skills, representing her two weapons: <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font>. Drag one skill onto the other to cast a combo skill.

Hirara has 2 <font color="a6aafb">Crimson / Death</font> Energy. Casting a combo skill consumes 1 <font color="a6aafb">Crimson / Death</font> Energy. Energy recovery time is the same as the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font>. Consuming Energy interrupts the recovery process.

Hirara only deals 30 (+4*Hero Level)% damage to minions.

skills.name: Meisen-e
skills.description: Hirara rides the waves using <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font>, performing up to two <font color="a6aafb">joystick dashes</font> (the first dash goes in her facing direction). She deals 150<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit.

skills.name: Kaerazu
skills.description:
Hirara uses <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font> to unleash the <font color="a6aafb">Crimson Maple</font>, dealing 165<font color="fba51f"> (+42% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area.

After a short delay, she deals damage again at the target location, dealing 2 times the initial <font color="a6aafb">Crimson Maple</font> damage.

skills.name: Twin Fans: Ukifune
skills.description:
Hirara has only two skills, representing her two weapons: <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font>. Drag one skill onto the other to cast a combo skill.

Hirara has 2 <font color="a6aafb">Crimson / Death</font> Energy. Casting a combo skill consumes 1 <font color="a6aafb">Crimson / Death</font> Energy. Energy recovery time is the same as the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font>. Consuming Energy interrupts the recovery process.

Hirara only deals 30 (+4*Hero Level)% damage to minions.

skills.name: Falling Maple
skills.description:
Hirara enhances <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font> with the power of <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> to cast a combo skill.
She becomes untargetable and immobilized for up to 1s.
After 0.6s, she deals 3 times <font color="a6aafb">Crimson Maple</font> damage, and can then cast the second <font color="a6aafb">joystick dash</font> of <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> to end these states early.

skills.name: Infernal Torrent
skills.description:
Hirara enhances <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font> with the power of <font color="a6aafb">Kaerazu</font> to cast a combo skill.
After casting the first <font color="a6aafb">joystick dash</font> of <font color="a6aafb">Meisen-e</font>, she spins, dealing 2.5 times the <font color="a6aafb">Crimson Maple</font> damage and immobilizing enemies for 0.8s.

skills.name: Fighting Spirit
skills.description:
Whenever Aulus deals skill damage to a unit, he gains an enhanced Basic Attack for 2s (capped at 4s).
Enhanced Basic Attack: Aulus raises his axe and slams it into the ground, dealing 120 (+12*Hero Level)<font color="fba51f"> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a line and recovering 15<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> HP. Enemies hit are slowed by 10% for 1s. Aulus also gains 0.5 Attack Range and 20% Attack Speed for 1s.
Enhanced Basic Attack deals 240 (+24*Hero Level)<font color="fba51f"> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to creeps.

skills.name: Aulus, Charge!
skills.description:
Aulus starts accumulating <font color="a6aafb">Fighting Spirit</font>, removes all slow effects, and gains 30% extra Movement Speed for 5s.

If Aulus does not take high-level control effects within 2s, he will enter the <font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font> state and gain Control Immunity.

skills.name: The Power of Axe
skills.description:
Aulus swings his axe, dealing 240<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area and stunning them for 0.3s.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Aulus dashes forward and smashes the ground, dealing 240<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Cleaving Axe
skills.description:
Aulus repeatedly swings his axe at nearby enemies, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> each time. After 4 strikes, Aulus briefly charges before unleashing a wider slash, dealing 450<font color="fba51f"> (+180% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a large area.

During this skill, Aulus gains 20% Damage Reduction and a short burst of Movement Speed with each slash.

skills.name: Platinum Snap
skills.description:
Marcel's split soul, <font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font>, enters the camera to freeze the moment. His Basic Attacks deal 50<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="62f8fe">(+40% Total Magic Defense)</font><font color="fba51f">(+40% Total Physical Defense)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. His <font color="26e407">Extra <1005></font> is converted into 1.5% <font color="26e407"><1999></font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font> automatically snaps photos of enemy heroes near Marcel, causing a brief <font color="a6aafb">Frozen Moment</font> and dealing 20 (+ 5% of <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> (triggers Attack Effects). It also grants a shield of the same value to Marcel and a nearby allied hero. Cooldown: 12s per target.

skills.name: Framed Moment
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font> focuses on an area around Marcel, slowing enemy heroes within by 60%.
After 2.5s, he completes the shot, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="62f8fe">(+120% Total Magic Defense)</font><font color="fba51f">(+120% Total Physical Defense)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies within.

skills.name: Tracking Shot
skills.description:
Artist inspiration time! Marcel enters the <font color="a6aafb">Tracking Haste</font> state for 3s, gaining 15% Movement Speed. This bonus increases to 75% when moving toward an enemy hero.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Marcel dashes in the target direction, leaving a framing phantom behind while the <font color="a6aafb">Framed Moment</font> area remains at the original location.

skills.name: Golden Hour
skills.description:
Marcel and <font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font> perform a joint shoot. After a short delay, <font color="a6aafb">Clemar</font> takes a wide-angle shot of the target area for 2s. During this time, Marcel enters the <font color="a6aafb">Tracking Haste</font> state while inside the area. All other units in the area are put into a <font color="a6aafb">Frozen Moment</font> and are immune to all effects except from Marcel. All projectiles are also frozen and will continue after a delay (targeted projectiles will deal 50% damage).

<font color="a6aafb">Golden Hour</font> resets the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Platinum Snap</font> for each enemy hero.
Allied heroes with the <font color="a6aafb">Platinum Snap</font> shield can move freely within the area.

skills.name: Superconductor
skills.description: Eudora's skills inflict <font color="a6aafb">Superconductor</font> for 5s on non-minion units hit and can trigger additional effects against enemies affected by <font color="a6aafb">Superconductor</font>.

skills.name: Forked Lightning
skills.description:
Eudora casts Forked Lightning in a fan-shaped area, dealing 275<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> (increased to 200% against minions) to enemies within.

When hitting targets affected by <font color="a6aafb">Superconductor</font>, Eudora forms a lightning chain with the target, gaining 40% Movement Speed during the chain for up to 1s.
The lightning chain deals 10<font color="62f8fe"> (+4% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> over time and an additional 275<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> when it ends. If this hit lands, it reduces this skill's cooldown by 50%.

skills.name: Ball Lightning
skills.description:
Eudora hurls an orb of lightning at the target enemy, reducing their <font color="62f8fe"><1070></font> by 10 for 1.8s, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, and stunning them for 1s.

If the target is affected by <font color="a6aafb">Superconductor</font>, the lightning orb reduces nearby enemies' <font color="62f8fe"><1070></font>, deals AOE damage centered on the target, and stuns all nearby enemies.

skills.name: Thunder’s Wrath
skills.description:
Eudora calls down lightning on the target area, dealing 540<font color="62f8fe"> (+145% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to targets at the center. A second strike then deals 270<font color="62f8fe"> (+90% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in the outer area.

When <font color="a6aafb">Thunder's Wrath</font> hits a target affected by <font color="a6aafb">Superconductor</font>, it triggers a <font color="a6aafb">Thunderburst</font> at the target's location after a short delay, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to them.

skills.name: Mystic Surge
skills.description:
Sora can ascend to <font color="a6aafb">Thunder</font> or <font color="a6aafb">Torrent</font> by using his Ultimate. After ascending, dealing damage to heroes or summoned units grants 1 stack of <font color="a6aafb">Cloudstep</font>. Upon reaching 5 stacks, he unlocks his True Art.

<font color="a6aafb">Thunder</font>: Adopts an assassin style, converting 30% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> into <font color="fba51f"><1020></font> (Equal to 10% of <font color="26e407"><1005></font>).
<font color="a6aafb">Torrent</font>: Adopts a tank style, converting 30% <font color="fba51f"><1020></font> into <font color="26e407"><1005></font> (Gains 10 HP for every 1 Attack).

skills.name: Sundering Strike
skills.description: Sora strikes twice, dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, then lunges forward, dealing 240<font color="26e407"> (+5% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. He can dash after striking.

skills.name: Windstride
skills.description: Sora leaps forward, dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+55% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. If he hits an enemy hero or reaches max range, he slams the ground, dealing an additional 140<font color="26e407"> (+8% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing them by 40% for 0.5s. Successful hits reduce the cooldown by 2s.

skills.name: Shifting Skies
skills.description:
Swipe left to ascend into <font color="a6aafb">Thunder</font> for 10s. Sora gains a brief bonus Movement Speed and becomes untargetable. He then summons lightning to strike nearby enemies 3 time(s), each dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

Swipe right to ascend into <font color="a6aafb">Torrent</font> for 10s. Sora gains Control Immunity. After a short delay, he pulls nearby enemies in and deals 250<font color="26e407"> (+8% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Torrent</font>: Adopts a tank style, converting 30% <font color="fba51f"><1020></font> into <font color="26e407"><1005></font> (Gains 10 HP for every 1 Attack).

skills.name: Sundering Strike - Thunderflash
skills.description: Sora strikes four times, dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, then lunges forward, dealing 240<font color="26e407"> (+5% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. He can move freely during this skill.

skills.name: Windstride - Thunder Rush
skills.description: Sora leaps forward, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. Upon hitting a hero or reaching the max distance, he summons a thunderstorm, dealing 120<font color="26e407"> (+6% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing enemies by 50% for 0.5s. This skill can be cast again within 4s if it hits an enemy.

skills.name: Heaven's Wrath
skills.description: Sora leaps into the air and strikes a target area 16 time(s), dealing 60<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> with each hit. Sora can move freely and ignore terrain during this skill.

<font color="a6aafb">Torrent</font>: Adopts a tank style, converting 30% <font color="fba51f"><1020></font> into <font color="26e407"><1005></font> (Gains 10 HP for every 1 Attack).

skills.name: Sundering Strike - Overwhelm
skills.description: Sora strikes twice, dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing enemies for 40%. He then lunges forward, dealing 240<font color="26e407"> (+5% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, stunning enemies for 0.5s.

skills.name: Windstride - Skyfall
skills.description: Sora leaps forward, dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+55% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, knocking enemies airborne, and knocking them back to the landing point. He then smashes the ground, knocking enemies airborne again for 0.5s, dealing 140<font color="26e407"> (+8% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, and slowing them by 50% for 1s. Hits reduce cooldown by 2s.

skills.name: Stormbind
skills.description: Sora leaps into the air and strikes the target area 5 time(s), dealing 100<font color="26e407"> (+6% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and briefly stunning enemies with each hit. Sora can move freely and ignore terrain during this skill.

skills.name: Return to Bone
skills.description:
Obsidia gains <font color="a6aafb">Bone Energy</font> whenever she deals damage. Basic Attacks grant 1 Energy against non-hero units and 2 against hero units or Turrets. Skills grant Energy equal to 3 times the amount granted by Basic Attacks against the same unit type. No Energy is gained from hitting creeps.
When <font color="a6aafb">Bone Energy</font> reaches 30, it forms a <font color="a6aafb">Bone Shard</font>, up to 25 shards. When Obsidia uses Basic Attacks, all <font color="a6aafb">Bone Shards</font> strike the target, each dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+6% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and inheriting 6% Attack Effects.
Killing an enemy hero directly grants 1 <font color="a6aafb">Bone Shard(s)</font>.
Obsidia's Basic Attacks deal 70<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, inheriting 100% Attack Effects.

skills.name: Abyssal Bone Needle
skills.description: Obsidia launches an <font color="a6aafb">Abyssal Bone Needle</font>, dealing 325<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and triggering <font color="a6aafb">Return to Bone</font> on the first enemy hero struck.

skills.name: Phantom Shadowmeld
skills.description: Obsidia descends into the Abyss and enters <font color="a6aafb">Shadowmeld Form</font>, gaining 500% Movement Speed for 0.3s.

skills.name: Hunt of Bone
skills.description:
Obsidia shoots <font color="a6aafb">Bones of Wrath</font> in the target direction, dealing 125<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and briefly stunning the first enemy hero hit before pulling herself to the target. The <font color="a6aafb">Bones of Wrath</font> tethers Obsidia to the enemy, preventing her from moving more than 4 units away. While tethered, the enemy cannot use mobility skills, and their movement drags Obsidia along. Obsidia also gains 5 temporary <font color="a6aafb">Bone Shards</font> stacks and a shield equal to 200 (+ 25 per <font color="a6aafb">Bone Shard</font> stack). This effect lasts 3s.

While tethered, Obsidia can move through obstacles and use Basic Attacks while moving. <font color="a6aafb">Phantom Shadowmeld</font> is also enhanced: its duration increases to 1s, and its cooldown is reduced to 33%.

skills.name: Celestial Armament
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Crown</font>: When Zetian hits enemy heroes with <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Strike</font> or <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Descent</font>, she gains 1% Spell Vamp for 5s (up to 10 stacks).

<font color="a6aafb">Celestial Robe</font>: The power of the Phoenix periodically protects Zetian, knocking back and stunning any enemy hero who approaches her, dealing 90 (+10*Hero Level)<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. She also gains a 300 (+20*Hero Level)<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> shield for 3s. Cooldown: 120s.

skills.name: Phoenix Strike
skills.description:
Zetian unleashes a <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Wave</font> in the target direction. If it hits an enemy, she automatically casts another wave (up to 3 times). Zetian can cast other skills during this time.

The waves deal 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font>, 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font>, and 360<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, respectively. The 3rd wave has a larger area and pulls enemies toward the cast direction (not considered a control effect).

The Spell Vamp ratio against minions is only 65%.

skills.name: Phoenix Descent
skills.description:
Zetian summons a <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Spirit</font> at the target location, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+45% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and applying a brief 50% slow effect to enemies in the area. The <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Spirit</font> hovers at the location for 3s, dealing 20<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> every 0.5s and reducing enemies' <font color="62f8fe"><1070></font> by 10% while revealing their surrounding area.
While the <font color="a6aafb">Phoenix Spirit</font> is active, Zetian can use this skill again to command it to charge toward a designated location, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+45% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and applying a brief 50% slow effect upon arrival.

skills.name: Fury of the Phoenix
skills.description:
Zetian calls upon her divine mandate and the hearts of her people, granting all allied heroes 40% Movement Speed that gradually decays over 3s, while bringing divine retribution upon all enemy heroes, dealing 400<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and stunning them for 0.8s. Zetian gains vision of all enemy heroes during this time.
Zetian can cast other skills while channeling this skill.

skills.name: Surge of Life
skills.description:
After casting a skill, Kalea creates a <font color="a6aafb">Water Zone</font> on the ground. When Kalea casts a skill within this zone, she absorbs it to enhance her next 3 Basic Attacks with different effects and gains 60% Movement Speed for 1s:
<font color="a6aafb">First Basic Attack</font>: Kalea dashes to the target, dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.
<font color="a6aafb">Second Basic Attack</font>: Kalea unleashes a flurry of attacks, dealing 140 (+8*Hero Level)<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and recovering <font color="26e407"> (+12% Max HP)</font>  <font color="62f8fe">(+80% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to herself and the nearby ally with the lowest HP.
<font color="a6aafb">Third Basic Attack</font>: Kalea strikes around the target with her tail, dealing 120 (+12*Hero Level)<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and creating a new <font color="a6aafb">Water Zone</font>. (Enhanced Basic Attacks are not affected by Attack Speed.)
<font color="A4AAC7">Control effects can affect Kalea during the third Enhanced Basic Attack, but cannot interrupt it.</font>

skills.name: Wavebreaker
skills.description: Kalea slams her fist into the ground, creating a wave that deals 200<font color="26e407"> (+5% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slows them by 40% for 1.5s.

skills.name: Tidal Strike
skills.description:
Kalea charges forward and body slams the first enemy hero she encounters, knocking them airborne for 0.6s (unaffected by Resilience) while dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.
If she collides with an obstacle or touches the edge of a <font color="a6aafb">Water Zone</font> during her charge, Kalea will leap into the air. Cast the skill again to slam down at a target location, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s (unaffected by Resilience).

skills.name: Tsunami Slam
skills.description: Kalea grabs an enemy hero with her tail and slams them down in the Joystick's direction (drag the Joystick to change landing spot). She gains Control Immunity during this process. Upon landing, deals 300<font color="26e407"> (+14% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target and nearby enemies.

skills.name: Hero's Resolve
skills.description:
Lukas gains 0.5 <font color="a6aafb">Resolve</font> per second and 3.5 <font color="a6aafb">Resolve</font> when dealing damage to heroes.
Upon reaching 100 Resolve, he can use <font color="a6aafb">Unleash the Beast</font> to transform into <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Beast</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Sacred Beast</font>: Greatly increases combat attributes. He continuously consumes <font color="a6aafb">Resolve</font> and ends when <font color="a6aafb">Resolve</font> is depleted.

skills.name: Flash Combo
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Basic Attacks grant Vigor (up to 2 stacks), each stack lasting 4s. Vigor enhances <font color="a6aafb">Flash Combo</font>.
Lukas consumes all Vigor to unleash Pulverize, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and recovering 8% of his <font color="26e407"><1005></font> when hitting a hero or minion.
<font color="a6aafb">1 Stack</font>: Lukas briefly stuns the target and spins his tonfa hammers to deal 95<font color="fba51f"> (+25% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> 3 times, pulling the enemy toward him.
<font color="a6aafb">2 Stacks</font>: Lukas briefly stuns the target, then delivers 2 attacks dealing 50<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> each. Afterward, he spins his tonfa hammers, dealing 95<font color="fba51f"> (+25% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> 3 times while gaining Control Immunity for the duration.

skills.name: Flash Step
skills.description:
Lukas dashes in the target direction, empowering his next Basic Attack within 4s into <font color="a6aafb">Flash Strike</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Flash Strike</font>: Lukas dashes behind the enemy, dealing 60<font color="fba51f"> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. He then gains 20% Movement Speed and Attack Speed for 4s. During this time, his next Basic Attack gains increased Attack Range and triggers a sacred lightning that deals 110<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

skills.name: Unleash the Beast
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">First Cast</font>: Lukas transforms into his <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Beast</font> form (briefly gains Control Immunity). His base Movement Speed is increased by 30, all attributes are increased by 15%, and his skills gain new effects.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Fires a <font color="a6aafb">Shockwave Blast</font> in the target direction that explodes upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its maximum range, dealing 450<font color="fba51f"> (+155% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

<font color="A4AAC7">All attributes</font>: <font color="26e407"><1005></font>, <font color="fba51f"><1020></font>, <font color="fba51f"><1060></font>, <font color="62f8fe"><1070></font>, Attack Speed, and Attack Range.

skills.name: Hero's Resolve
skills.description:
Lukas gains 0.5 <font color="a6aafb">Resolve</font> per second and 3.5 <font color="a6aafb">Resolve</font> when dealing damage to heroes.
Upon reaching 100 Resolve, he can use <font color="a6aafb">Unleash the Beast</font> to transform into <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Beast</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Sacred Beast</font>: Greatly increases combat attributes. He continuously consumes <font color="a6aafb">Resolve</font> and ends when <font color="a6aafb">Resolve</font> is depleted.

skills.name: Flash Combo
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Basic Attacks grant Vigor (up to 2 stacks), each stack lasting 4s. Vigor enhances <font color="a6aafb">Flash Combo</font>.
Lukas consumes all Vigor to unleash a tail swing, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and recovering 8% of his <font color="26e407"><1005></font> when hitting a hero.
<font color="a6aafb">1 Stack</font>: Lukas briefly stuns the target and pounces, dealing 95<font color="fba51f"> (+25% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> 3 times and knocking the enemy back.
<font color="a6aafb">2 Stacks</font>: Lukas briefly stuns the target and leaps, dealing 50<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> 2 times. Afterward, he summons sacred lightning, dealing 95<font color="fba51f"> (+25% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> 3 times while gaining Control Immunity for the duration.

skills.name: Flash Step
skills.description:
Lukas dashes in the target direction, empowering his next Basic Attack within 4s into <font color="a6aafb">Lightning Clash</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Lightning Clash</font>: Lukas charges toward the enemy, knocking them back and dealing 60<font color="fba51f"> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. He then gains 20% Movement Speed and Attack Speed for 4s. During this time, his next Basic Attack gains increased Attack Range and triggers a sacred lightning that deals 110<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

skills.name: Shockwave Blast
skills.description: The Sacred Beast fires a Shockwave Blast in the target direction (gains Control Immunity during the cast) that will explode upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its maximum range, dealing 450<font color="fba51f"> (+155% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

skills.name: Transient Immortal
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Tap-casting</font> any skill puts Suyou in <font color="a6aafb">Mortal Form</font>, granting 40 Movement Speed and reducing the interval between his Basic Attacks.
<font color="a6aafb">Hold-casting</font> any skill puts Suyou in <font color="a6aafb">Immortal Form</font>, increasing his Basic Attack damage to 125% and granting 20% Physical Damage Reduction.
In this form, Suyou gains 1% Physical Damage Reduction for every 20 <font color="fba51f">extra <1020></font> he has, up to 40%.

skills.name: Blade Surge
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Tap</font>: Suyou throws his weapon in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path. Suyou then blinks to the weapon's location, catches it, and performs a slash in the opposite direction, dealing 375<font color="fba51f"> (+150% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.
<font color="a6aafb">Hold</font>: Suyou channels the Immortal's power and charges in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the path. When hitting an enemy hero, he stops and stuns enemies in a rectangular area in front for 0.6s. The charge distance increases with the hold time.
<font color="A4AAC7">Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted</font>.

skills.name: Soul Sever
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Tap</font>: Suyou performs a sweeping attack with his weapon, dealing <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 280<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> (+ 15% of target's <font color="26e407">lost <1997></font>) to enemies in a fan-shaped area.

<font color="a6aafb">Hold</font>: Suyou channels the power of the Immortal to perform 3 cleaves in a fan-shaped area. The first two strikes deal 225<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> each, while the final strike deals 360<font color="fba51f"> (+128% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and recovers 150<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Extra Physical Attack)</font> HP for himself.

skills.name: Evil Queller
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Tap</font>: Suyou glides backward and swings his weapon in the target direction, dealing 420<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a rectangular area and on his path backward, and reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5s.
<font color="a6aafb">Hold</font>: Suyou uses the Immortal's power to shoot a deadly arrow in the target direction, dealing 580<font color="fba51f"> (+165% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target hit. The range increases with the hold time. 
<font color="A4AAC7">Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted</font>.

skills.name: Crimson Butterflies
skills.description:
Every time Zhuxin channels <font color="a6aafb">Lantern Flare</font>, she converts the Mana spent into up to 15 <font color="a6aafb">Crimson Butterflies</font> to follow her <font color="a6aafb">Spirit Lantern</font>. After Zhuxin stops channeling <font color="a6aafb">Lantern Flare</font>, the <font color="a6aafb">Crimson Butterflies</font> will gradually disappear, each restoring 5% of her Max Mana.
Zhuxin has a naturally high base Max Mana, but it doesn't scale with her level.

skills.name: Fluttering Grace
skills.description: Zhuxin deals 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to all enemies in a fan-shaped area and applies 1 stack(s) of <font color="a6aafb">Soul Snare</font>. Zhuxin also slows all enemy heroes hit by 20% and gains 20% of extra Movement Speed herself for 1.5s.

skills.name: Lantern Flare
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Hold</font>: Hold the skill button to move the <font color="a6aafb">Spirit Lantern</font>. It deals 35<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to all enemies in range every 0.33s (Magic Bonus increases to 60% against minions) and applies <font color="a6aafb">Soul Snare</font> to enemy heroes hit. When an enemy hero reaches 10 stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Soul Snare</font>, the <font color="a6aafb">Crimson Butterflies</font> capture them, pulling them airborne for 1s.

<font color="a6aafb">Release</font>: Throw all captured enemies to the target location, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 10% captured target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to all enemies in the area. If an enemy is hit multiple times, subsequent damage decays by 80%.

After a target is captured, <font color="a6aafb">Soul Snare</font> cannot stack on them again for 4s. During this time, this skill deals 15% extra damage to that target.

skills.name: Crimson Beacon
skills.description: Zhuxin blinks to the target location, gaining a 400<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> shield and creating a field for 6s. The field deals 30<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and applies 1 stack of <font color="a6aafb">Soul Snare</font> to nearby enemies every 0.5s.

skills.name: Snack Time!
skills.description:
While out of combat, Chip takes a bite of potato chips every 2s. After 4 bites, he finishes a bag and recovers HP equal to 300 (+ 45% of his <font color="26e407">lost <1997></font>).

After finishing a bag, Chip cannot eat again for 5s. (His bite count is retained if he enters combat before finishing the bag.)

skills.name: Crash Course
skills.description: Chip rams his hovercraft into the ground, dealing <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to 100 plus 4% of the target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font> and applying <font color="a6aafb">Chip's Mark</font> on enemy units hit. Chip gains a 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> Shield upon hitting an enemy hero, which increases by 40% for each additional enemy hero hit. Chip's next Basic Attack will become ranged and also hit all nearby enemies with <font color="a6aafb">Chip's Mark</font>, detonating the mark to deal 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and stun each target for 0.6s.

skills.name: Overtime
skills.description:
Chip rushes for 2s, gaining up to 65% extra Movement Speed, after which he maintains the max speed for 2s.

Chip's next Basic Attack will cause him to charge at the enemy, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and knocking them back slightly.

skills.name: Shortcut
skills.description:
Chip drops the <font color="a6aafb">Main Portal</font> on an enemy hero, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and briefly slowing them by 25%. The Main Portal deals 2 times the damage and immobilizes them for 1s after a delay. Meanwhile, he creates <font color="a6aafb">Connecting Portals</font> near allied heroes 10 units away and behind the allied Base. The <font color="a6aafb">Main Portal</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Connecting Portals</font> last up to 15s.
<font color="a6aafb">Connecting Portal</font>: Heroes (on both teams) can teleport from <font color="a6aafb">Connecting Portals</font> to the <font color="a6aafb">Main Portal</font>, and allied heroes gain Burst Movement Speed for 1.5s and a 500 shield.
<font color="a6aafb">Main Portal</font>: The Main Portal inherits 70% of Chip's attributes. Heroes can stand on the <font color="a6aafb">Main Portal</font> for 2s to return to the <font color="a6aafb">Connecting Portal</font> they came from. Casting skills or launching Basic Attacks will reset the stand time.

skills.name: Why Walk?
skills.description: Chip has 4 fixed <font color="a6aafb">Beacons</font> on the map when the battle starts. Use this skill to teleport to any other <font color="a6aafb">Beacon</font>. (This skill cannot be used in combat.)

skills.name: Performer's Delight
skills.description: Cici generates a stack of Delight after dealing damage, increasing her Movement Speed by 0.75% and Spell Vamp by 1.25% per stack up to 10 times, doubling the effects at full stacks.

skills.name: Yo-Yo Blitz
skills.description:
Cici uses Yoyo to continuously attack the nearest enemy within range (prioritizing heroes) for 3.5s, hitting them up to 10 times, and dealing <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 65 plus 3.5<font color="fba51f"> (+1.2% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of the target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font> per hit. Cici can move and use other skills during this attack.

If there is no enemy within range, Yoyo will attack Turrets or the Base instead.

This skill deals 20% extra damage to Minions.

skills.name: Buoyant Bounce
skills.description: Cici leaps to a target location. If she lands on any unit (not including Turrets and Base), she can leap again in the Joystick's direction. If she lands on an enemy with the first leap, she deals 200<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to them.

skills.name: Curtain Call
skills.description:
Cici throws Yoyo at the target enemy hero and links them with another nearby enemy hero, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+10% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, slowing them by 30%, and pulling them together for 4s. 

During this time, Cici can use <font color="a6aafb">Yo-Yo Blitz</font> to attack both linked targets at the same time. If only one target is within the range of <font color="a6aafb">Yo-Yo Blitz</font>, Cici will attack the target twice, but the damage of the second attack will be reduced to 25%.

skills.name: Dimensional Rift
skills.description:
Nolan's skills will leave a <font color="a6aafb">Rift</font>. When a rift comes into contact with another rift, they will <font color="a6aafb">activate</font> and pull enemies to their center and deal 240<font color="fba51f"> (+140% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> after a short delay. Each time a rift activation hits an enemy, Nolan will gain 25 Energy. If an enemy is hit by multiple rift activations, the damage after the first hit will be reduced by 40%.
<font color="a6aafb">Cosmic Leap</font>: If Nolan does not deal or take damage for 5s, he enhances his next Basic Attack to dash to the target, dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and leaving a <font color="a6aafb">Rift</font>. (Damage to and from Minions or Creeps will not prevent Nolan from getting this effect.)

skills.name: Expansion
skills.description: Nolan cuts a rectangular area in front of him with his cosmic gauge, dealing 230<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and leaving a <font color="a6aafb">Rift</font> at the first enemy hit.

skills.name: Gauge
skills.description: Nolan charges in the target direction and slashes with his cosmic gauge, dealing 70<font color="fba51f"> (+13% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in his path and leaving a <font color="a6aafb">Rift</font>.

skills.name: Fracture
skills.description: Nolan slashes at the target location 3 times, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> with each slash while leaving 3 rifts and slowing the target hit by 30% for 0.5s. The rifts will be activated automatically while Nolan dashes backward.

skills.name: Siphon Starlium
skills.description:
Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Starlium Charge</font> to enemies on hit. When Ixia performs a Basic Attack on an enemy with two stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Starlium Charge</font>, the attack consumes the stacks and is replaced by <font color="a6aafb">Siphon Starlium</font>, dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="26e407"><88 200></font> +(+10*Hero Level) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target. Ixia recovers HP equal to the damage dealt (only 10<font color="26e407"> <88 150></font>% against non-hero units) and slows the target by 25% for 1s.
<font color="a6aafb">Siphon Starlium</font> can hit all enemies in front of Ixia within her Basic Attack range, but it cannot Crit.
Ixia's Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal.

skills.name: Dual Beam
skills.description:
Ixia fires 2 Starlium-charged energy beams along the ground in the target direction, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a rectangular area. When hitting enemy heroes, Ixia gains 50% Movement Speed for 2s.
Enemies hit by both beams will take double damage.

skills.name: Star Helix
skills.description: Ixia unleashes a canister of Starlium energy in the target direction, knocking back nearby enemies. After a short delay, it pulls enemies in range to the center line and deals 200<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

skills.name: Full Barrage
skills.description: Ixia reassembles her weapon into 6 smaller weapons and enters the <font color="a6aafb">Full Barrage</font> state for 4s. In this state, Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills can hit enemies in the large fan-shaped area in front of her, but not outside it. Ixia's Basic Attacks can hit up to 6 enemy units (prioritizes heroes), and <font color="a6aafb">Siphon Starlium</font> will fire simultaneously with her normal Basic Attacks.

skills.name: Demon Gaze
skills.description:
Arlott possesses a demonic eye that will <font color="a6aafb">Mark</font> enemy units near Arlott that become affected by control effects for 7s.
The eye will also automatically <font color="a6aafb">Mark</font> a nearby enemy hero in vision every 7s.

skills.name: Dauntless Strike
skills.description: Arlott swings his lance forward, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and briefly stunning targets in an area. Targets hit by the farther part of the AOE will be stunned for 1s instead.

skills.name: Vengeance
skills.description:
Arlott charges at an enemy, dealing 135<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> (this skill cannot be interrupted during movement).
If Arlott's target is <font color="a6aafb">Marked</font>, he gains a brief burst of Movement Speed, and this skill will deal double damage, immediately refresh its cooldown, and recover 70<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> HP to Arlott (only restores 50% of that amount when used on a non-hero unit).

skills.name: Final Slash
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Each level-up reduces <font color="a6aafb">Demon Gaze</font>'s interval by 1s.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Arlott cleaves forward, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area, knocking them back to the edge of the swing, and briefly revealing their location (can only be interrupted by Suppression).

skills.name: Star Trail
skills.description: <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font> continuously slows nearby enemies by 20% and reveals their position.

skills.name: Astral Meteor
skills.description: Novaria summons an <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font> at the target location, dealing 75<font color="62f8fe"> (+25% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> every 0.33s and continuously slowing enemies (up to 2.5 times). After 2s, the <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font> explodes, dealing 260<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 4% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slowing enemies by 2.5 times.

skills.name: Astral Recall
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">First Cast</font>: Novaria summons an <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font> at a distance and draws it toward her. She gains 80% Movement Speed (decays to 30%) and can pass through obstacles.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Upon catching the <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font>, she can cast <font color="a6aafb">Star Shatter</font> to launch it in the target direction within 5s. Upon hitting an enemy hero, it deals 260<font color="62f8fe"> (+95% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 5% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to them and nearby heroes. The damage will increase based on the <font color="a6aafb">Astral Sphere</font>'s travel distance (draw + launch), up to 2.2 times the original damage.

skills.name: Astral Echo
skills.description: Novaria scatters <font color="a6aafb">Astral Echo</font> in the target direction, briefly slowing enemy heroes hit by 50% and applying <font color="a6aafb">Astral Ring</font> on them. This increases their hitbox by 2.5 times and reveals their position for 5s.

skills.name: Humph, Joy's Angry!
skills.description:
Joy becomes <font color="a6aafb">Angry!</font> each time her skill hits a non-Minion enemy, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and increasing her Movement Speed by 60% that decays over 4s (hitting the <font color="a6aafb">Leonin Crystal</font> will also grant the Movement Speed effect). This effect has a cooldown of 4s for each target.

Joy's Basic Attack will deal 65<font color="fba51f"> (+65% Total Physical Attack)</font>  <font color="62f8fe">(+65% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.

skills.name: Look, Leonin Crystal!
skills.description: Joy summons a <font color="a6aafb">Leonin Crystal</font> at the target location, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The <font color="a6aafb">Leonin Crystal</font> lasts up to 2s.

skills.name: Meow, Rhythm of Joy!
skills.description:
Joy dashes in the target direction, dealing 120<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in her path. Hitting an enemy or the <font color="a6aafb">Leonin Crystal</font> allows Joy to cast this skill again within 0.8s and gain 1 <font color="a6aafb">Beat Energy</font>. Casting this skill on the beat increases the skill damage by 100% and grants a 80<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> shield that lasts 3s.

This skill can be cast up to 4 times in succession.

skills.name: Ha, Electrifying Beats!
skills.description:
Joy gains 15<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="26e407"><1999></font> and 30% Movement Speed. Over the next 3s, she pulses 8 times, dealing 120<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> each time to nearby enemies.
Each <font color="a6aafb">Meow, Rhythm of Joy!</font> cast on the beat increases this skill's damage by 40%. If perfect rhythm is achieved by hitting every beat with <font color="a6aafb">Meow, Rhythm of Joy!</font>, Joy also gains 40% Spell Vamp while this skill is active.

This skill unlocks when Joy acquires <font color="a6aafb">Beat Energy</font>. Casting this skill with 3 <font color="a6aafb">Beat Energy</font> will remove all debuffs and make her immune to slow effects while this skill is active.

skills.name: Crystalline Armor
skills.description:
Fredrinn gains 1 <font color="a6aafb">Combo Point</font> that lasts 5s each time his skill hits a non-minion enemy, up to 4 <font color="a6aafb">Combo Points</font>. His Ultimates cost different numbers of <font color="a6aafb">Combo Points</font>.

Fredrinn stores 100% of the damage he receives as <font color="a6aafb">Crystal Energy</font>, which decays after 5s at a rate of 10% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> per second.
Fredrinn can convert the stored <font color="a6aafb">Crystal Energy</font> into HP by 20% of his damage dealt (10% for damage dealt to minions). Gaining a <font color="a6aafb">Combo Point</font> resets the decaying timer.

skills.name: Piercing Strike
skills.description:
Fredrinn thrusts his sword in the target direction, dealing 125<font color="26e407"> (+7% Max HP)</font> <font color="fba51f">(+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s. His next Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals 85<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.
This skill deals 170% damage to non-hero enemies.

skills.name: Brave Assault
skills.description: Fredrinn dashes in the target direction, dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first non-minion enemy hit. His next Basic Attack knocks the target airborne for 0.3s.

skills.name: Energy Eruption
skills.description:
Fredrinn deals 210<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and taunts them for 1s. Hitting a non-minion enemy grants Fredrinn 25 <font color="26e407"><1999></font> for 3s and reduces the cooldowns of <font color="a6aafb">Piercing Strike</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Brave Assault</font> by 75%.
This skill costs 1 <font color="a6aafb">Combo Point</font>.

skills.name: Appraiser's Wrath
skills.description:
Fredrinn slams his sword in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 600 plus 21% of his <font color="a6aafb">Crystal Energy</font> as <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area after a short delay. Enemies in the center of the area take 175% damage. This skill doubles the conversion ratio based on damage dealt to enemy heroes from stored <font color="a6aafb">Crystal Energy</font> to HP.
This skill costs 3 <font color="a6aafb">Combo Points</font>.

skills.name: Smith's Legacy
skills.description:
After casting two different skills, Julian enhances his third skill. Casting the enhanced skill makes all his skills go on a 9-6s Cooldown (decreases with his level).
After casting any skill, his Basic Attacks for the next 2s will deal 100<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and pull the target toward him (deals 85% damage to Creeps). Casting another skill extends the duration.
Julian gains 15% extra Hybrid Lifesteal for 5s each time he hits an enemy hero with his skills (up to 3 stacks).

skills.name: Scythe
skills.description:
Julian hurls a flying scythe in the target direction, dealing 420<font color="62f8fe"> (+140% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1s.
The scythe disappears upon hitting a non-minion enemy.

skills.name: Sword
skills.description: Julian summons a flying sword and dashes in the target direction, dealing 400<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies along the way.

skills.name: Chain
skills.description: Julian casts chains at the target location, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit after a short delay and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

skills.name: Smith's Legacy
skills.description:

Yu Zhong applies <font color="a6aafb">Sha Residue</font> to enemy heroes each time he damages them.

<font color="a6aafb">Sha Residue</font> erupts upon reaching 5 stacks on a target. Then it begins consuming 1 stack every 0.4s to deal <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 20<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Extra Physical Attack)</font> (+ 2.5% of target's <font color="26e407"><1998></font>) to the target. Each stack consumed recovers 6% of Yu Zhong's <font color="26e407"><1998></font>. Yu Zhong also gains 30% Movement Speed for 3s.

skills.name: Dragon Tail
skills.description: Yu Zhong infuses his power into his cloak and turns it into a weapon, which starts to attack nearby enemies after a short delay. The inner area of the cloak deals 220<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, whereas the sharpened edge deals 275% damage and applies 2 stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Sha Residue</font>.

skills.name: Soul Grip
skills.description:
Yu Zhong unleashes the Dragon Soul, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to all enemies in front and slowing them by 60% for 1s. 

Upon hitting an enemy, Yu Zhong's next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 108<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. Upon hitting multiple enemies, the enhanced Basic Attack will apply multiple stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Sha Residue</font> and deal up to 200% damage.

skills.name: Furious Dive
skills.description:
Yu Zhong leaps towards the designated area with his full strength, dealing 180<font color="fba51f"> (+90% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. He is able to dash one more time in the movement direction. 
After a short delay, enemies within the area of effect will be knocked airborne for 0.6s and take 180<font color="fba51f"> (+90% Extra Physical Attack)</font> additional <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

skills.name: Black Dragon Form
skills.description:
After channeling for 0.6s, Yu Zhong transforms into his Black Dragon Form. For up to 7s, he cannot use other skills but can move freely and will knock back enemy heroes in his path while dealing 180<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. He also gains 1000<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="26e407"><1005></font>, becomes immune to control effects, and ignores obstacles in this form.
Upon exiting the Black Dragon Form, Yu Zhong enters <font color="a6aafb">Dragonoid Form</font>, gaining increased range on all of his skills for 10s.

skills.name: We Are Friends
skills.description:
Kupa recovers 10% Max HP per second after not taking damage for 5s. When Kupa dies, Popol can <font color="a6aafb">Pray</font> for 3s to revive it. Cooldown: 30s.

Kupa has 3500<font color="ffe63c"> (+350*Hero Level)</font> Max HP and inherits 100% of Popol's other attributes and equipment effects.
Kupa deals 77 <font color="ffe63c">(+3*Hero Level)</font> extra <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> to creeps.

skills.name: Bite 'em, Kupa!
skills.description:
Popol throws a spear at the target, signaling Kupa to attack and dealing 80<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. Kupa then bites the target, dealing 40<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing them by 99% for 0.75s.
While marked by the spear, whenever Popol or Kupa hits the target with a Basic Attack, both gain 7% Attack Speed and 3% Movement Speed for 4s (up to 3 stacks).
<font color="a6aafb">Alpha Wolf Form</font>: Kupa strikes fiercely, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+140% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target and nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for 0.5s.

skills.name: Kupa, Help!
skills.description:
Popol calls Kupa back and gains a 240<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> shield. He can then ride Kupa for 1.5s, gaining 250 Movement Speed while mounted. Kupa also continuously recovers 20% of its Max HP.
Popol can use a Basic Attack to end the <font color="a6aafb">Mounted</font> state early. After returning, Kupa follows Popol until Popol attacks an enemy.
<font color="a6aafb">Alpha Wolf Form</font>: Shield effect increases to 125%, and Kupa recovers full HP while <font color="a6aafb">Mounted</font>.

skills.name: Popol's Surprise
skills.description:
Popol sets a trap. After a short delay, it immobilizes the enemy stepping on it for 1s. It then explodes to create a frost zone for 4s, which continuously slows enemies within by 20%.

Popol gains a trap charge every 22s (up to 3 charges). Up to 4 traps can exist at the same time, each lasting up to 60s.

skills.name: We Are Angry!
skills.description:
Popol and Kupa enter the <font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font> state for 9s.
During this time, Kupa turns into <font color="a6aafb">Alpha Wolf Form</font>, immediately recovering full HP and gaining <Num3> extra Max HP, while <font color="a6aafb">enhancing</font> its other skills.

skills.description:
Atlas generates <font color="a6aafb">Frigid Breath</font> around him for 4s each time he casts a skill. Enemies affected by <font color="a6aafb">Frigid Breath</font> will have their Movement Speed gradually reduced over 2s, after which they'll be frozen for 0.5s.

Atlas gains 20<font color="26e407"> (+0.5% Extra Max HP)</font> extra <font color="26e407"><1999></font> when <font color="a6aafb">Frigid Breath</font> is present.

skills.name: Annihilate
skills.description:
Atlas smashes the ground and causes 3 explosions, dealing 400<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies.

<font color="a6aafb">Ejected State</font>: If Atlas is ejected from his Mecha Sentry, both he and his Mecha will cast Annihilate.

skills.name: Perfect Match
skills.description:
Atlas enters <font color="a6aafb">Ejected State</font>, gaining 30% Movement Speed and immunity to Slowing Effects. In this state, the Mecha Sentry will follow the pilot at an increasing speed (can only be controlled by Suppression). Once they meet, Atlas will return to the Mecha, dealing 320<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies nearby and stunning them for 0.8s.
<font color="a6aafb">Ejected State</font>: Atlas and his Mecha share the same HP bar and reduce 50% of the damage taken in this state.

skills.name: Fatal Links
skills.description:
Atlas hurls chains around and starts to channel (can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 225<font color="62f8fe"> (+75% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemy heroes hit and slowing them by 40% for 3s.

Use this skill in <font color="a6aafb">Ejected State</font>: The Mecha Sentry will return to Atlas immediately, but the stun effect will be replaced by 40% Slowing Effect.

skills.name: Vampire Pact
skills.description: Each time Carmilla deals damage to an enemy hero, she steals 6-13 <font color="26e407"><1999></font> (scales with level) from them. The stolen <font color="26e407"><1999></font> can stack up to 5 times and lasts 5s. However, Carmilla can only steal defense from the same enemy hero once every 3s.

skills.name: Crimson Flower
skills.description:
Carmilla summons three Crimson Flowers that circle around her for 5s, dealing 85<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> each time they hit an enemy and slowing them by 6% for 0.8s (the slow effect stacks up to 30%).

Carmilla recovers 45<font color="62f8fe"> (+21% Total Magic Power)</font> HP each time a Crimson Flower deals damage (only recovers 30% of that amount when hitting minions).

skills.name: Bloodbath
skills.description:
Carmilla accumulates Bloodbath Energy, gaining 70% Movement Speed that decays over 4.5s.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Carmilla unleashes the accumulated Bloodbath Energy on the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and stunning them for 0.6s. The damage and stun duration scale with the accumulation time (up to 100%).

skills.name: Curse of Blood
skills.description:
Carmilla casts Curse of Blood on the target location, slowing enemies hit by 50%. After 0.8s, enemies still within the area will take 450<font color="62f8fe"> (+130% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, and will be immobilized for 1s, slowed by 30% and linked for 5s.

When a linked enemy takes damage or becomes controlled, all the other linked targets take 50% of the damage and become controlled for 100% of the duration. Enemies can move away from one another to break the link.

skills.name: Overflowing
skills.description:
Cecilion gains 10 extra Max Mana and recovers 10 Mana each time his skill hits an enemy. Cooldown: 1s.

Cecilion has higher Max Mana and Mana Regen, and his skill damage scales with his Max Mana.

skills.name: Bat Impact
skills.description:
Cecilion commands a giant bat to dive at the target location, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed for 1s, dealing 85<font color="62f8fe"> (+70% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="a6aafb">(+7% Total Mana)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in its path. The bat also deals 170<font color="62f8fe"> (+140% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="a6aafb">(+14% Total Mana)</font> extra <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to those near the landing point, and applies <font color="a6aafb">Overflowing</font> effect once.

Each subsequent cast within 6s increases this skill's Mana cost by 1.5 times (up to 4 stacks).

skills.name: Sanguine Claws
skills.description: Cecilion summons a pair of opposing claws at the target location that will clasp together after a short delay, pulling enemies in their paths to the center while dealing them 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+45% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="a6aafb">(+1.2% Total Mana)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and immobilizing them for 1s.

skills.name: Bats Feast
skills.description:
Cecilion unleashes his Blood Demon power, gaining 60% Movement Speed (decays over the duration) and Slow Immunity for 1.5s.

Meanwhile, he fires 36 bolts of blood energy at nearby enemies, each dealing 35<font color="62f8fe"> (+8% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="a6aafb">(+0.3% Total Mana)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slowing enemies hit by 3% for 1s (up to 30%total).
Each bolt that hits restores HP equal to 10 plus 1% of Cecilion's <font color="26e407">lost <1997></font>.

skills.name: Moonlit Waltz
skills.description:
When Carmilla is nearby, Cecilion can summon her to become a Vermil Shadow around him, granting him a 520-800 shield (scales with Carmilla's level).
Carmilla can choose to leave Cecilion and charge at the target location, gaining an equal shield while dealing 520-800 <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> (scales with level) to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1s.

skills.name: Knightess' Resolve
skills.description:
Silvanna's Basic Attacks deal 25<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+75% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.
Silvanna's attacks apply a mark on enemy heroes for 5s on hit, each mark reducing their <font color="26e407"><1999></font> by 3-6 (up to 5 stacks).
Silvanna's skills and Basic Attacks deal 30% extra damage to enemy heroes with the max number of marks.

skills.name: Cometic Lance
skills.description: Silvanna dashes forward. Upon reaching the max range or hitting a non-Minion enemy, she swings her lance, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and stunning them for 1s.

skills.name: Spiral Strangling
skills.description:
Silvanna thrusts her lance in the target direction and spins it 6 times while gaining a 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> shield. Each spin deals 165<font color="62f8fe"> (+45% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slightly pulls targets toward the center. Silvanna spins 1 additional time for every 50% of extra Attack Speed she possesses.

The skill deals only 50% damage against Minions.

<font color="a6aafb">Spiral Strangling</font> counts as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.

skills.name: Imperial Justice
skills.description:
Silvanna leaps to the target location and creates a Circle of Light upon landing, dealing 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+110% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in the area, slowing them by 40% for 1.5s, and restraining the closest enemy hero to the area for 3.5s. (This skill cannot be interrupted.)

Silvanna gains 100% Attack Speed and 40% Lifesteal when in the Circle.

skills.name: Tiger Pace
skills.description:
Enemy heroes hit by Wanwan's attacks will have their weaknesses and positions exposed for 5s. When hitting an enemy's weakness, Wanwan deals 67 (+3*Hero Level) extra <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> and increases their damage taken from her subsequent attacks by 10% for 5s.
Wanwan can dash a short distance after each arrow fired from her Basic Attack. The dash speed scales with her Attack Speed.

skills.name: Swallow’s Path
skills.description: Wanwan throws a Fire Swallow in the target direction, triggering <font color="a6aafb">Tiger Pace</font> while dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path. The Fire Swallow then turns into 3 rotating Swallow Daggers. After a short delay, these Swallow Daggers will fly back to Wanwan one after another, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies on their way back and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. Enemies hit twice by the Swallow Daggers will be immobilized for 0.5s.

skills.name: Needles in Flowers
skills.description: Wanwan removes all debuffs on herself and triggers <font color="a6aafb">Tiger Pace</font>. Meanwhile, she shoots Deadly Needles in all directions, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit.

skills.name: Crossbow of Tang
skills.description:
Wanwan leaps into the air and becomes untargetable, firing arrows at the target enemy hero for 2.5s in rapid succession, dealing 60<font color="fba51f"> (+35% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> per arrow. If the target is killed during this attack, Wanwan will switch to another enemy hero in her attack range, gain 30% Attack Speed, and extend the skill duration by 1s (this effect can trigger up to 3 times). Wanwan can trigger <font color="a6aafb">Tiger Pace</font> upon killing an enemy and at the end of the duration.
<font color="a6aafb">Crossbow of Tang</font> can only be cast on enemy heroes with all their weaknesses hit and Wanwan gains 100% Movement Speed during the duration. This damage is regarded as Basic Attack damage, and the firing rate scales with Wanwan's Attack Speed.

skills.name: Primal Pact
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Bear's Blessing</font>: Masha has 3 HP bars, each inheriting 50% of her Equipment HP bonuses. Each time an HP bar breaks, she removes control effects on herself and blocks one instance of damage. Dealing damage to enemy heroes or creeps builds <font color="a6aafb">Feral</font>, which converts into HP after she leaves combat.
<font color="a6aafb">Power of Wildness</font>: When Masha's skills damage an enemy hero, a <font color="a6aafb">Wound</font> appears on a random side of the target. Breaking a <font color="a6aafb">Wound</font> with a Basic Attack puts her into the <font color="a6aafb">Feral</font> state.
<font color="a6aafb">Feral State</font>: For 3s, Masha gains 15<font color="ffe63c"> (+1*Hero Level)</font>% Resilience, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed. Her next 3 Basic Attacks become fan-shaped claw strikes, dealing extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 3<font color="fba51f"> (+0.5% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="ffe63c">(+0.2*Hero Level)</font>% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> to enemies in the area (not against Turrets) and recovering 4<font color="ffe63c"> (+0.4*Hero Level)</font>% HP.
[C8Breaking another <font color="a6aafb">Wound</font> during the <font color="a6aafb">Feral</font> state refreshes the state's duration. Up to 6 claw strikes can be stored.]
