skills.description: Masha releases energy forward, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+55% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path. It deals 150% damage to minions.

skills.name: Claw Strike
skills.description:
Masha dashes in the target direction, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and reducing enemy heroes' Movement Speed by 50% for 1s on hit.

[C8Whenever an HP bar is depleted, the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Claw Strike</font> resets.]

skills.name: Savage Maul
skills.description: Masha charges toward an enemy hero, dealing 300<font color="26e407"> (+50% Extra Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and stunning them for 1s while knocking back nearby enemies.

skills.name: Baxia Mark
skills.description:
Baxia activates the "Baxia Mark" permanently, reducing the final damage received by 15 (+1*Hero Level).
At the same time, Baxia will reduce the Shield and HP Regen of enemies hit by his skills by 40% for 4s.

skills.name: Baxia-Shield Unity
skills.description:
Baxia retracts himself into his shield and accelerates forward. When hitting an enemy unit, he will deal 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to it and nearby enemies, stunning the target for 0.8s and slightly knocking nearby enemies back.
During the process of accelerating forward, use this skill again to launch Baxia upward so that he can cross obstacles and enemy minions. When leaping up, if there is an enemy hero under Baxia, he will strike this hero, dealing 375<font color="62f8fe"> (+75% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to this hero and nearby enemies, stunning the target hit for 1.5s, and slightly knocking other nearby enemy targets back.

skills.name: Shield of Spirit
skills.description:
Baxia throws out his shield, dealing 120<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 5% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies along the way, marking them for 5s, and slowing them by 50% for 1s. The shield disappears upon hitting the first enemy hero or creep.
Baxia can cast the skill again in a short while. If an enemy hero or creep is hit by the skill, the skill's cooldown will be reduced to 15%.

skills.name: Tortoise’s Puissance
skills.description:
Baxia holds his shield to the front and begins sprinting frantically, gaining 30% extra Movement Speed for 10s while leaving a lava path behind. Enemies on the path will take 40<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and be slowed by 15% for 0.5s every 0.5s.
For the duration, the Damage Reduction effect from <font color="a6aafb">Baxia Mark</font> is increased to 200%.

skills.name: Angry Gloom
skills.description:
Lylia gains power from <font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font>, increasing her Movement Speed by 15%. Each <font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font> upgrade further increases this bonus by 5%.
<font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font> gains an upgrade each time he devours <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Energy</font>, up to 5 times. Higher levels increase the detonation damage of <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Energy</font>.

skills.name: Magic Shockwave
skills.description:
Lylia sends out <font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font> with a shockwave, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in a line and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s.
If <font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font> touches <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Energy</font>, he will devour and detonate it.

skills.name: Shadow Energy
skills.description:
Lylia condenses <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Energy</font> at the target area, dealing 90<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and briefly slowing them by 80%.
<font color="a6aafb">Shadow Energy</font> detonates when devoured by <font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font>, dealing 220<font color="62f8fe"> (+115% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies. Each <font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font> upgrade increases the detonation damage by 20% (up to 80%).
<font color="a6aafb">Gloom</font> restores 20% of <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Energy</font>'s recharge time upon hitting an enemy hero.
Lylia starts with the <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Energy</font> skill, storing one charge every 6s.

skills.name: Black Shoes
skills.description:
Lylia returns to the Black Shoes' location 4s ago, restoring her HP and Mana to their previous state and recovering an extra 10% <font color="26e407"><1005></font>.
She also gains 20% Movement Speed for 2s.

skills.name: Wrath of the Abyss
skills.description:
When Dyrroth's Rage reaches 50%, he enhances <font color="a6aafb">Burst Strike</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Spectre Step</font>.

After every 2 Basic Attacks, Dyrroth releases a Circle Strike, dealing<font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font>-<font color="fba51f"> (+180% Total Physical Attack)</font> (scales with level) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the circle (enhanced damage does not apply to turrets), and recovering <font color="26e407">7%</font>-<font color="26e407">10%</font> <font color="26e407"><1005></font> (scales with level, halved against minions or turrets). This strike does not trigger Attack Effect.
Each time he damages an enemy, the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Burst Strike</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Spectre Step</font> is reduced by 1s.

Dyrroth recovers 2% - 5% Rage per second (scales with level).

skills.name: Burst Strike
skills.description:
Dyrroth releases a burst strike in a designated direction. Each burst deals 240<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies and slows them by 25% for 1.5s. (The damage decays against the same target and decreases to only 75% on minions.)

<font color="a6aafb">Abyss Enhanced</font>: Burst Strike has a longer range, deals 140% of the original damage, and its Slowing Effect is doubled.

skills.name: Spectre Step
skills.description:
Dyrroth dashes in the target direction. He stops upon reaching the max distance or hitting an enemy hero or creep, dealing 230<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slightly knocking them back.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Dyrroth locks onto a target and unleashes a Fatal Strike, dealing 345<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and reducing their <font color="fba51f"><1060></font> by 40% for 4s.

<font color="a6aafb">Abyss Enhanced</font>: Fatal Strike reaches further and deals 150% of the original damage, slows the target by an extra 90%, and reduces their <font color="fba51f"><1060></font> by 60% for 4s.

skills.name: Abysm Strike
skills.description:
After a short delay, Dyrroth launches a destructive strike in the target direction, dealing 650<font color="fba51f"> (+250% Extra Physical Attack)</font> (+ 25% of the target's <font color="26e407">lost <1997></font>) as <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path, and slowing them by 55% for 0.8s.
This skill can only be interrupted by <font color="a6aafb">Suppression</font>.
Damage dealt to non-hero enemies is capped at 1500.

skills.name: Cloud Walker
skills.description:
Ling's superb Lightness Skill allows him to leap among walls. He gains 4 extra Lightness Points per second when he's on a wall and 5 extra Lightness Points each time he deals damage.

Ling gains 1.6 times Crit Chance from all sources but only has 140% Crit Damage.

skills.name: Finch Poise
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Ling's Crit Chance is increased by 2.5%.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Ling leaps onto the designated wall and enters the <font color="a6aafb">Half-Stealth</font> state, restoring Lightness Points faster and gaining 30% Movement Speed. Taking damage causes him to leave <font color="a6aafb">Half-Stealth</font>. Being controlled makes him fall to the ground and slows him by 30% for 2s. When he uses this skill to jump from one wall to another, it does not trigger cooldown and refreshes <font color="a6aafb">Half-Stealth</font>.

skills.name: Defiant Sword
skills.description:
Ling charges in the target direction and stabs nearby enemies, dealing them 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.
If Ling casts this skill when he's on the wall (no energy cost), he'll dash to the target location on the ground, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. 
<font color="a6aafb">Defiant Sword</font> is regarded as Basic Attack.

skills.name: Tempest of Blades
skills.description:
Ling leaps into the air, becoming invincible and gaining 10% extra Movement Speed for 1.5s. He ignores obstacles when in the air. He then lands on the ground, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s, knocking those in the center airborne for 1s, and creating a Sword Field for 8s.

Four <font color="a6aafb">Tempest of Blades</font> will also appear on the edge of the Sword Field. Ling can touch them to reduce the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Finch Poise</font> by 4s, reset the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Defiant Sword</font>, and gain 25 Lightness Points.

skills.name: Firaga Armor
skills.description:
Firaga Armor inherits 160% of X.Borg's <font color="26e407"><1005></font> and absorbs all incoming damage when it's active. When destroyed, X.Borg rolls in the direction of the Joystick (he is invincible during this process). The Armor's energy will gradually regenerate while X.Borg is in the Armorless State. At full energy, X.Borg re-equips the Armor and restores it to 30% HP.
X.Borg's attacks cause enemies to enter the <font color="a6aafb">Overheated</font> state. Enemies in the <font color="a6aafb">Overheated</font> state will drop Firaga Supplies when they take damage from X.Borg. Picking up supplies restores 10% of the Armor's HP (or 10 Energy while in the Armorless State).
X.Borg's skills deal <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> to enemies in the <font color="a6aafb">Overheated</font> state.

skills.name: Fire Missiles
skills.description:
X.Borg sprays fire, dealing 25<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> 7 times over 2s to enemies in front of him (75% damage to minions). 

Armorless State: The attack area becomes narrower but longer, while the damage is reduced to 60%.

skills.name: Fire Stake
skills.description:
X.Borg fires 5 Fire Stakes forward and recalls them after 1.7s. Each stake deals 50<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and pulls enemies and Firaga Supplies along its path back to him.

Armorless State: X.Borg adjusts the Fire Stake launcher, making the stakes travel farther and closer together.

skills.name: Last Insanity
skills.description:
X.Borg charges in the target direction while spinning and spraying fire (cannot pick up Firaga Supplies during this time), dealing 90<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+45% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> 12 times and slowing enemies hit by 25%. He stops upon touching an enemy hero and will slow them by an additional 40%.
After 3s, his mecha suit detonates, dealing 300 (+ 15% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font>. If his armor is destroyed, it will immediately explode, but damage drops to 50%. The detonation destroys his armor, removes all control effects, and collects all nearby Firaga Supplies. Cannot be used in <font color="a6aafb">Armorless State</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Immediately stop spraying fire and detonate early.

skills.name: Body of Smith
skills.description:
Terizla gains 1% extra Damage Reduction (up to 20 (+1*Hero Level)%) for every 2.5% HP lost.
He cannot gain extra Attack Speed and will convert every 1% extra Attack Speed into 1 <font color="fba51f"><1020></font>.

skills.name: Revenge Strike
skills.description:
Terizla strikes the ground with his hammer, sending a fissure forward that deals 300<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. Upon hitting its first target, the fissure burrows into them, slowing them by 15%. Terizla also gains 15% Movement Speed for 3.5s.

The fissure then explodes, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> (+ 20% of the target's <font color="26e407">lost <1997></font>) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

skills.name: Execution Strike
skills.description:
Terizla swings his hammer in a fan-shaped area ahead. This skill can be cast up to 3 times. The first two attacks deal 90<font color="fba51f"> (+135% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> each, while the third deals 225<font color="fba51f"> (+220% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 20% for 1.25s (the Slowing Effect can stack).
Deals only 80% damage to Minions.

skills.name: Penalty Zone
skills.description: Terizla jumps to the designated area, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s. He then summons Scaffold and slows enemies by 25%. Scaffold will send out a hook at enemy heroes in range and pull them several times while dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> each time.

skills.name: Starmoon Casket
skills.description:
Esmeralda manipulates Stardust and Frostmoon: Stardust deals Physical Damage while Frostmoon deals Magic Damage and gives the target a shield equal to 135% of Frostmoon's damage dealt. Each Basic Attack deals <font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+75% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.
The damage dealt by Esmeralda ignores all shield effects and gradually converts her shield into HP.

skills.name: Frostmoon Shield
skills.description: Esmeralda gains a 500<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> shield and 40% Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 4s. Meanwhile, she gradually transforms the shields of nearby enemies into her own shield, capped at 50% of her <font color="26e407"><1005></font>.

skills.name: Stardust Dance
skills.description: Esmeralda waves Stardust and Frostmoon, dealing 240<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies. Each time she deals damage to a hero, the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Frostmoon Shield</font> is reduced by 1.5s (damaging non-hero units grants a 0.5s reduction) and the enemy's Movement Speed is reduced by 20% for 1.5s.

skills.name: Falling Starmoon
skills.description:
Esmeralda coheres the power of Astrospace into her two weapons - Stardust and Frostmoon. The longer this skill is channeled, the longer the cast range.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Esmeralda casts Stardust at the target location, dealing 350<font color="fba51f"> (+90% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, and then blinks to the target location and casts Frostmoon, dealing 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+140% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and immobilizing enemies in the area for 1s.

skills.name: Super Magic
skills.description:
Guinevere deals 25% extra damage to airborne enemies. Her Basic Attacks also deal <font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.
Guinevere gains <font color="a6aafb">Super Magic</font> stacks each time she deals damage. At max stacks, her next Basic Attack becomes a guided attack, dealing 80<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+90% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and recovering <font color="26e407">80 (+ 8% of her <1998>)</font>.
Enemies hit by Guinevere's skills or enhanced Basic Attack are marked for 5s. Enemies with 3 marks are knocked airborne when hit by <font color="a6aafb">Violet Requiem</font>.

skills.name: Energy Wave
skills.description:
Guinevere releases an energy orb in the target direction, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+125% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slowing enemies by 25% for 1.2s.
Successfully hitting an enemy reduces all her skill cooldowns by 1s.

skills.name: Spatial Migration
skills.description:
Guinevere leaps to the target location, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. Enemy heroes and Creeps hit will be knocked airborne for 1s and take 125<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> additional <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.
<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Guinevere blinks toward the target direction and leaves an illusion behind. If the illusion takes damage by hero, it restores Super Magic for Guinevere and explodes after 1.5s, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Violet Requiem
skills.description:
Guinevere creates a force field around her, gaining Control Immunity while attacking nearby enemies 11 times within 2s, dealing 880<font color="62f8fe"> (+385% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> in total.
Airborne enemies hit will be knocked airborne again, up to 8 additional times.

skills.name: Capriccio
skills.description:
Granger's unique Demon Hunting <font color="a6aafb">Gun</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Cannon</font> are powered by Demonic Energy. Both his weapons start with 800 max Energy. His <font color="a6aafb">Gun</font> restores 8% Energy per second while his <font color="a6aafb">Cannon</font> restores 2% Energy per second. Killing a Minion / Creep permanently increases their max Energy by 6 / 6, and instantly restores their Energy by 5% / 5%, respectively. Each kill or assist on an enemy hero permanently increases both weapons' max Energy by 12 and instantly restores 10% Energy.

Every 1% Cooldown Reduction converts to 2 <font color="fba51f"><1020></font>. Demonic Energy costs are not affected by Energy Cost Reduction.

skills.name: Rhapsody
skills.description:
Granger rapidly fires 6 shot(s) with his <font color="a6aafb">Gun</font>, with each shot dealing 60<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and consuming 70 <font color="a6aafb">Gun</font> Energy. The last shot is guaranteed to Crit. While firing, Granger's Movement Speed is increased by 10%.

Granger stops firing when he runs out of Energy, or when the skill is cast again. <font color="a6aafb">Rhapsody</font> has no cooldown and can be cast once his <font color="a6aafb">Gun</font> Energy is over 420.

skills.name: Rondo
skills.description:
Granger uses his Demon Hunter agility to dash in the target direction, instantly restoring 15% Energy for his <font color="a6aafb">Gun</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Rondo</font> can be cast while channeling <font color="a6aafb">Rhapsody</font>. Each time <font color="a6aafb">Rhapsody</font> hits an enemy, <font color="a6aafb">Rondo's</font> Cooldown is reduced by 0.5s.

skills.name: Death Sonata
skills.description:
Granger fires his <font color="a6aafb">Cannon</font> in the target direction, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+110% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hero hit and other targets in the blast radius. Targets hit will be briefly slowed. Granger can roll in the Joystick's direction after each shot.
<font color="a6aafb">Death Sonata</font> can be cast while firing <font color="a6aafb">Rhapsody</font>. <font color="a6aafb">Death Sonata</font> has a brief cooldown and consumes 250 of Granger's <font color="a6aafb">Cannon</font> Energy per shot.

skills.name: Spell Curse
skills.description:
Khufra activates the <font color="a6aafb">Spell Curse</font> left by Esmeralda every 8s, enhancing his next Basic Attack. The enhanced Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals 100<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</font> (+ 6% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. He also slows the target by 30% for 1.5s and recovers 8% of his <font color="26e407"><1005></font> on hit.

Each time Khufra applies a control effect to an enemy hero with his skill, the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Spell Curse</font> is reduced by 4s.

skills.name: Tyrant's Revenge
skills.description: Khufra pulls the bandages on his arms to launch himself in the specified direction, dealing 50 (+ 7<font color="fba51f"> (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of his <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to all enemies on the path. When blinking to the furthest distance or encountering the first enemy hero, Khufra will immediately stop, dealing 50 (+ 7<font color="fba51f"> (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of his <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for up to 1s.

skills.name: Bouncing Ball
skills.description:
Khufra uses bandages to wrap himself into a <font color="a6aafb">Bouncing Ball</font>, increasing his <font color="26e407"><1999></font> by 30%. Enemies trying to use mobility skills to move across Khufra will be knocked airborne.

Each time the <font color="a6aafb">Bouncing Ball</font> hits the ground, it deals 50 (+ 3<font color="fba51f"> (+2% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of his <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slows them by 80% for 0.2s.

skills.name: Tyrant's Rage
skills.description: Khufra pushes back all enemy targets around him toward his front (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing them down for 1.25s. If the enemies are knocked against walls, extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 150% of this skill's damage will be inflicted upon them, and they will be stunned, instead of slowed.

skills.name: Chivalry Fist
skills.description:
Every time Badang's Basic Attack hits a target, he gains a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Chivalry Fist</font>. After gaining 4 stacks, his next Basic Attack deals 50<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and knocks them back. Enemies that are knocked into obstacles will be stunned for 0.6s (Minions and Creeps are stunned directly).
<font color="a6aafb">Fist Wind</font> generated by Badang's skills will trigger this effect directly, and <font color="a6aafb">Fist Wind</font> from his Ultimate increases the stun duration to 1s.

skills.name: Fist Wind
skills.description:
Badang unleashes a gust of <font color="a6aafb">Fist Wind</font> in the target direction, dealing 125<font color="fba51f"> (+90% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit, slowing them by 30% for 1.5s, and knocking them back. The <font color="a6aafb">Fist Wind</font> will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies. <font color="a6aafb">Fist Wind</font> can trigger attack effects and grants Badang 1 <font color="a6aafb">Chivalry Fist</font> stack upon cast.
Badang stores up to 2 <font color="a6aafb">Fist Wind</font> charges and restores 1 charge every 10.4s.

skills.name: Fist Break
skills.description:
Badang dashes in the target direction, dealing 230<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in his path while gaining a 350<font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font> shield that lasts 5s. He stops immediately upon hitting an enemy hero, slightly knocking them back while creating an obstacle that lasts 4s behind them. Enemies hit by the obstacle are dealt 130<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Badang removes the obstacle he created.

skills.name: Fist Crack
skills.description:
Badang throws a flurry of punches in the target direction, dealing 60<font color="fba51f"> (+54% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit multiple times (can trigger attack effects). The <font color="a6aafb">Fist Wind</font> generated by the punches will explode upon hitting an obstacle, dealing 30<font color="fba51f"> (+27% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies.
Badang is immune to control effects for the duration.

skills.name: Vicious Retrieval
skills.description:
When Faramis's skills deal damage to enemy heroes and summoned units, they leave behind <font color="a6aafb">Soul Fragments</font>. Absorbing a <font color="a6aafb">Soul Fragment</font> recovers 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> HP and grants 2 <font color="62f8fe"><1030></font> (up to 40 stacks).
Upon death, he consumes the absorbed <font color="a6aafb">Soul Fragments</font> to reduce the respawn timer, each reducing the timer by 3% (up to 90%).
He can gain up to 1 Soul Fragment from the same enemy hero using skills every 4s. Enemies that die around Faramis also have a chance to drop <font color="a6aafb">Soul Fragments</font>.

skills.name: Shadow Stampede
skills.description:
Faramis enters the Shadow state for 3s, gaining 70% Movement Speed, 25 <font color="26e407"><1999></font>, and 20% Cooldown Reduction of this skill. He also gains the ability to move through terrain. Enemy heroes he touches take 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and are marked with a Nether Mark. Upon leaving the Shadow state, Faramis pulls all the marked enemy heroes toward him, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.
<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Ends the Shadow state early to pull marked enemy heroes toward him.
Soul Fragment absorption range is increased while this skill is active.

skills.name: Ghost Bursters
skills.description: Faramis gathers Nether energy in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing 330<font color="62f8fe"> (+144% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within. The energy will then split and bounce to nearby enemies, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+86% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> (splits up to 2 time(s) on enemy hero hits and 1 time(s) on non-enemy hero hits).

skills.name: Nether Realm
skills.description: Faramis turns his surroundings into the <font color="a6aafb">Nether Realm</font> for 6s. Allied heroes within (including himself) enter the <font color="a6aafb">Specter</font> state, gaining 400 (+ 10<font color="62f8fe"> (+5% Total Magic Power)</font>%) extra HP and 50% extra Movement Speed for 1s. When the <font color="a6aafb">Specter</font> state breaks, heroes within clear all debuffs and enter a brief Resurrection state for 1.3s. The <font color="a6aafb">Specter</font> state immediately ends if the allied hero leaves the <font color="a6aafb">Nether Realm</font>.

skills.name: Thalassophobia
skills.description:
Kadita gains the <font color="a6aafb">Blessing of the Ocean</font> every 30s. Taking damage from an enemy hero activates the Blessing for 4s.

When the Blessing ends, she recovers 65% of the HP lost during this period (damage from minions and creeps does not activate this effect).

While in the River, Kadita gains 10% extra Movement Speed.

skills.name: Ocean Ode
skills.description:
Kadita summons an ocean wave to carry herself in the target direction and back, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+90% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. While inside the wave, she gains Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction. This skill can pass through obstacles and terrain.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Kadita exits the wave without interrupting the wave's movement.

skills.name: Breath of the Ocean
skills.description:
After a short delay, Kadita summons an ocean wave to erupt at the target location, dealing 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+140% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 1s.

Kadita can cast this skill during <font color="a6aafb">Ocean Ode</font> to summon an ocean wave beneath her with a shorter eruption delay.

skills.name: Rough Waves
skills.description:
Kadita dives into the ground and sends ocean waves in all directions, each dealing 270<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit by multiple waves take increased damage. After a delay, the waves return to Kadita, each dealing 180<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit.

While underground, Kadita becomes untargetable and gains 60% Movement Speed.
This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.

skills.name: Mark of the King
skills.description: Minsitthar's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Mark of the King</font>, up to 5 stacks. Upon reaching max stacks, the next attack detonates all <font color="a6aafb">Mark of the King</font> stacks, dealing <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 400<font color="26e407"> (+6% Max HP)</font> of Minsitthar's Max HP and stunning the target for 0.8s while healing Minsitthar for 400<font color="26e407"> (+6% Max HP)</font> HP. Can only trigger once every 6s on the same target.

skills.name: Spear of Glory
skills.description:
Minsitthar thrusts the <font color="a6aafb">Spear of Glory</font> forward, dealing 175<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing enemies hit by 30%. Enemy heroes hit by the spear tip are stunned for 0.3s.

After a short delay, Minsitthar pulls the spear back, dealing 175<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to all enemies in its path and pulling enemy heroes toward him. Pulled heroes are stunned for up to 0.8s based on the distance pulled.

skills.name: Shield Assault
skills.description: Minsitthar awakens the power in his shield and releases it, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to all enemies in a rectangular area and slowing them by 80% (decaying rapidly over 2s). Meanwhile, he enters <font color="a6aafb">Phalanx</font> state for 3s, reducing damage taken from the front by 25% and enhancing his Basic Attack to swiftly strike an area in front of him for 100<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> per hit.

skills.name: King's Calling
skills.description:
Minsitthar charges forward and calls 4 Royal Guards to form a field around him. The Royal Guards cannot move but will attack enemies in the field and deal <font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to them.
Enemies in the field are slowed by 30% and cannot use movement skills.

skills.name: Key Insight
skills.description: Harith gains insight from his Key. He gains 7% Hybrid Lifesteal for each nearby enemy hero, stacking up to 35%.

skills.name: Synchro Fission
skills.description:
Harith creates a phantom of himself in a distant location. Harith and his phantom then release <font color="a6aafb">Synchro Fission</font> toward each other, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to all enemy units on the path.

When the 2 energy waves collide, they explode, dealing 450<font color="62f8fe"> (+180% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to all enemies in the area.
This skill deals 60% extra damage to creeps (up to 1500 damage).

skills.name: Chrono Dash
skills.description:
Harith dashes towards the target direction, gaining a 120<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> shield that stacks up to 3 times and enhancing his next Basic Attack. His enhanced Basic Attack deals 200<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="62f8fe">(+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slows enemies by 40%. Hitting an enemy reduces the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Chrono Dash</font> by 3s.

The enhanced Basic Attack only deals 50<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="62f8fe">(+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to Turrets.

skills.name: Zaman Force
skills.description:

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: During this time, he dashes toward an enemy hero, dealing 250 (+ 8% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and knocking the target back for 1s.
Aldous can interrupt the target's Recall while dashing.

skills.name: Symbiosis
skills.description:
Selena can switch freely between her two forms.
<font color="a6aafb">Elven Form</font>: Selena applies <font color="a6aafb">Abyssal Mark</font> when her skills deal damage. Marks last 8s and can stack up to 2 times.
<font color="a6aafb">Abyssal Form</font>: Selena's Basic Attacks become melee and deal <font color="62f8fe"> (+25% Total Magic Power)</font> additional <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. Her skills deal 240-450<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> additional <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies with <font color="a6aafb">Abyssal Mark</font> and consume their mark stacks by 1. This damage is increased to 250% against Creeps and Minions.

skills.name: Abyssal Trap
skills.description:
Selena summons an Abyssal Devil to lurk underground. The Abyssal Devil will attach itself to any enemy that approaches, inflicting a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Abyssal Mark</font> and reducing their Movement Speed by 50% for 1s. The Abyssal Devil then explodes, dealing 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in the area and reducing their Movement Speed by 50% for 1s.

Each additional Abyssal Devil on an enemy increases the final damage by 50%.

Each Abyssal Devil can lurk up to 60s and up to 3 Abyssal Devils can exist at the same time.

skills.name: Abyssal Arrow
skills.description:
Selena fires an abyssal wraith in the target direction that stops when it hits an enemy hero, Creep, or Summon, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+20% Total Magic Power)</font> to 500<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the target hit and stunning them for 0.5s to 2.5s while revealing their locations (the damage and stun duration increase with the wraith's travel distance).

The wraith will pick up <font color="a6aafb">Abyssal Trap</font> as it travels over it and will apply the <font color="a6aafb">trap</font> to the enemy target upon stunning them.

If the wraith stuns an enemy for 0.9s or longer, Selena will gain 60% Movement Speed for 2s.

skills.name: Primal Darkness
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Selena gains 5 <font color="62f8fe"><1030></font>.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Selena enters <font color="a6aafb">Abyssal Form</font> and gains 20% Movement Speed for 0.8s. This also immediately resets the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Soul Eater</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Garotte</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Elven Form</font>: Selena applies <font color="a6aafb">Abyssal Mark</font> when her skills deal damage. Marks last 8s and can stack up to 2 times.
