This damage is increased to 250% against Creeps and Minions.

skills.name: Soul Eater
skills.description:
Selena strengthens her claws with the power of the Abyss, causing the next Basic Attack to dash to a target and deal an additional 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+130% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> while granting her a 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> shield.

If this damage detonates an <font color="a6aafb">Abyssal Mark</font>, <font color="a6aafb">Garotte's</font> cooldown will reset.

skills.name: Garotte
skills.description:
Selena charges in the target direction, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in her path.

If this skill's damage detonates an <font color="a6aafb">Abyssal Mark</font>, its cooldown will reset.

skills.name: Blessing of the Moon Goddess
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Selena gains 5 <font color="62f8fe"><1030></font>.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Selena enters <font color="a6aafb">Elven Form</font> and gains 20% Movement Speed for 0.8s. This also immediately resets the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Abyssal Trap</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Abyssal Arrow</font>.

skills.name: Wings of Lightning
skills.description: Kaja's skill damage applies the <font color="a6aafb">Paralysis</font> effect to enemy units, briefly slowing heroes or summoned units and reducing their damage by 8% for 5s.

skills.name: Ring of Order
skills.description:
Kaja summons a ring of Primal Lightning that expands and returns to him.
Enemies hit take 160<font color="62f8fe"> (+70% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and recover 78<font color="62f8fe"> (+45% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to Kaja. Healing from subsequent hits is reduced to 33%.

skills.name: Soaring Wings
skills.description:
Kaja dashes to the target area, gaining Control Immunity during the dash. On arrival, he deals 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, knocking back and stunning nearby enemies for 0.5s, then enters the <font color="a6aafb">Soaring</font> state.
The <font color="a6aafb">Soaring</font> state lasts 6.6s. During this time, he ignores obstacles and gains 15% Movement Speed, but his turn radius is restricted. He can use Basic Attacks while moving, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+25% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 2% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to surrounding enemies. Each Basic Attack hit extends the <font color="a6aafb">Soaring</font> state by 0.2s.
Upon entering the <font color="a6aafb">Soaring</font> state, the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Soaring Wings</font> is reduced to 4s (unaffected by Cooldown Reduction). Hitting an enemy with <font color="a6aafb">Soaring Wings</font> extends the <font color="a6aafb">Soaring</font> state by 2.6s.

skills.name: Divine Binding
skills.description:
Kaja hurls a <font color="a6aafb">Primal Lightning Lasso</font> at the target area. After a 0.5s delay, all enemy heroes remaining in the area take 360<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and are trapped for 2.5s.

While active, Kaja can drag the lasso, shrinking its radius and pulling enemies at the boundary along with him (does not interrupt their skills).

skills.name: Trouble Maker
skills.description: Each time Chang'e deals damage to an enemy, she leaves a mark on them that reduces their Movement Speed by 1% (up to 20%).

skills.name: Starmoon Shockwave
skills.description:
Chang'e sends an energy sphere in the target direction, dealing 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+130% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in its path and slowing them by 10% for 1.5s.

<font color="a6aafb">Crescent Moon</font>: The <font color="a6aafb">Crescent Moon</font> sends 4 extra energy spheres along with Chang'e's, each dealing 20% damage and slowing enemies hit. The slow effect can stack (up to 20%).

skills.name: Crescent Moon
skills.description:
Chang'e summons the <font color="a6aafb">Crescent Moon</font>, gaining a permanent 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> shield and 10% Movement Speed until the shield is broken. Each time she casts a skill, she gains an extra 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s.
<font color="a6aafb">Crescent Moon</font>: Enhances her Basic Attacks to deal 20<font color="62f8fe"> (+35% Total Magic Power)</font> extra <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> 2 times.

Each time Chang'e deals Magic Damage with her Basic Attacks or skills, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 0.2s.

skills.name: Meteor Shower
skills.description:
Chang'e gains 10% Movement Speed for 4s. During this time, she fires 30 meteors in the target direction, each dealing 60<font color="62f8fe"> (+21% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the first enemy hit. This skill deals 100% extra damage to minions and creeps.

<font color="a6aafb">Crescent Moon</font>: Fires meteors alongside Chang'e, each dealing 33% damage.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Petal Barrage
skills.description:
Hanabi's Basic Attacks and skills launch <font color="a6aafb">Petal Blades</font> upon hitting a target, dealing 30% damage and bouncing up to 4 times to nearby enemies. <font color="a6aafb">Petal Blades</font> launched by Basic Attacks inherit Attack Effects.
If bounces from the same Basic Attack or skill hit the same target multiple times, subsequent bounces deal 30% less damage.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Equinox
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Whenever Hanabi has a shield from any source, she is immune to control effects.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Hanabi gains a 300<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> shield for 5s. When the shield is active, she gains 20% Movement Speed and 25% Attack Speed, and 20% of her damage dealt to enemy heroes is added to this shield (only 10% of the damage dealt to non-hero units is added). This shield cannot exceed 50% of her <font color="26e407"><1005></font>.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Soul Scroll
skills.description: Hanabi fires the energy Kunai in the targeted direction, dealing 350<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way and reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 1s. Enemy units hit will also be marked, allowing Hanabi's next Bounce Damage from Basic Attacks to deal 30<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> on them with no damage decay.

skills.name: Forbidden Jutsu: Higanbana
skills.description: Hanabi throws Higanbana in the targeted direction, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hero hit and immobilizing them for 0.8s. After 1s, Higanbana will bloom at the location of the first hit, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies. Subsequent hits on the same target decay to 30% damage.

skills.name: Radiance
skills.description:
Each time Uranus takes damage, he gains a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Radiance</font>. Each stack recovers 1.2-11.2 HP (increases with level) every 0.8s for 10s, up to 20 stacks.
Uranus's Basic Attacks deal <font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="a6aafb">(+ 4-8 × Radiance stacks)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> (increases with level).

skills.name: Ionic Edge
skills.description:
Uranus releases 2 energy blades that orbit around him, dealing 155<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="a6aafb">(+6 × Radiance stacks)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s.
Each blade can only damage the same target once.

skills.name: Transcendent Ward
skills.description:
Uranus charges to the target location, dealing 80<font color="62f8fe"> (+20% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies along the way, and 160<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies at the target location and slowing them by 25%. Uranus also generates a 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+200% Total Magic Power)</font> shield for 4s.

The shield explodes at the end of its duration or when destroyed, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies nearby.

skills.name: Consecration
skills.description:
Uranus unleashes the energy stored within his body, removing slow effects on himself, recovering 200 HP, and gaining 60% Movement Speed for 8s (decays over time).

Uranus directly gains 5 stacks of Radiance, increasing shields received and HP Regen by 20% for 8s.

skills.name: Asura's Wrath
skills.description: Each time Martis uses a skill, his Attack Speed will be increased by 30%, 120% maximum. Lasts 4s. He gains (+8*Hero Level) extra Attack at full stacks.

skills.name: Asura Aura
skills.description: Martis draws enemies to a fan-shaped area in front of him and deals 350<font color="fba51f"> (+130% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, slowing them by 40% for 2s.

skills.name: Mortal Coil
skills.description:
Martis strikes in the target direction three times, each time dealing 225<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit. Enemies hit by the first and third strike are also knocked back. The attack direction can be changed once using the Joystick.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Martis leaps in the target direction, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+150% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in his path and knocking them airborne.
Martis gains Control Immunity and 60% Damage Reduction when casting this skill.

skills.name: Decimation
skills.description:
Martis lunges at a designated enemy hero, dealing 700<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> (deals True Damage if the enemy's HP is below 50%).
If the enemy is killed by this skill, Martis can cast the skill again within 10s and gains 100% extra Movement Speed that gradually decays over 5s. Each successive cast also increases the skill's damage by 15% (up to 30%).

skills.name: Ashing
skills.description:
Valir's skills apply a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Ablaze</font> to enemies hit, dealing them <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to 1<font color="62f8fe"> (+0.2% Total Magic Power)</font>% of their <font color="26e407"><1005></font> per second for 3s.

At 3 stacks, the fire detonates, dealing <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to 5<font color="62f8fe"> (+1% Total Magic Power)</font>% of the target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font> and stunning them for 1s.
A target can only be stunned by Valir's skills once every 7s.

skills.name: Burst Fireball
skills.description:
Valir launches a fireball that explodes upon hitting the first target, dealing 235<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The flame on the ground explodes after 1s, dealing 118<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.

Valir recharges 1 fireball every 9s (up to 2 charges). Hitting an enemy hero or legend creep with this skill immediately restores 1 charge, while hitting a minion restores 4s of the recharge time.

<font color="a6aafb">Vengeance Flame</font>: Increases the cast range of <font color="a6aafb">Burst Fireball</font> by 30%.

skills.name: Searing Torrent
skills.description:
Valir unleashes a torrent of flames in the target direction, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and knocking them back to the end of its path.

<font color="a6aafb">Vengeance Flame</font>: The torrent forms a firewall at the end of its path that lasts 4s, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies every 1s.

Enemies hit by the torrent or the firewall are slowed by 25% for 1s.

skills.name: Vengeance Flame
skills.description: Valir removes all debuffs on himself and gains 40% Movement Speed that decays over 3s. Meanwhile, he conjures 4 <font color="a6aafb">Vengeance Flames</font> that enhance <font color="a6aafb">Burst Fireball</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Searing Torrent</font> for 9s.

skills.name: Dagger Specialist
skills.description: Each skill cast adds a rune to Gusion's dagger (stacks up to 4 times). Each stack enhances Gusion's next Basic Attack to deal additional damage equal to 3% of the target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font> and recover 50<font color="62f8fe"> (+25% Total Magic Power)</font> HP for himself.

skills.name: Sword Spike
skills.description:
Gusion throws a dagger in the target direction, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the first enemy hit and marking them.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Gusion moves behind the marked enemy, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to them. This skill cannot be interrupted while Gusion is moving behind the marked enemy.

skills.name: Shadowblade Slaughter
skills.description:
Gusion throws a volley of daggers in the target direction, each dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 6% for 2s (when hit by multiple daggers, the slow effect can stack up to 30%).

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Gusion recalls the daggers, each dealing 65<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in its path.

skills.name: Incandescence
skills.description:
Gusion dashes to the target location, resetting the cooldowns of <font color="a6aafb">Sword Spike</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Shadowblade Slaughter</font>. If <font color="a6aafb">Shadowblade Slaughter</font> was cast once before the reset, Gusion can throw another five daggers on his next <font color="a6aafb">Shadowblade Slaughter</font> cast, and recall a total of ten daggers afterward.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Gusion dashes a short distance in the target direction.

skills.name: Smart Heart
skills.description: Angela gains 5% extra Movement Speed for 4s each time she casts a skill (up to 20%). When she's attached to an allied hero, the Movement Speed boost is transferred to the allied hero.

skills.name: Love Waves
skills.description:
Angela sends <font color="a6aafb">Love Waves</font> in the target direction, dealing 170<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit, revealing their positions briefly, and applying a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Lover's Mark</font> (up to 5 stacks). Each stack of <font color="a6aafb">Lover's Mark</font> increases the damage by 20% and slows enemies hit by 8% for 3s.
<font color="a6aafb">Love Waves</font> also restore 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+75% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to allied heroes hit. Angela can store up to 5 charges of this skill, and the charge time is affected by Cooldown Reduction.
<font color="a6aafb">When attached to allies, this skill's cooldown is reduced by 50%.</font>

skills.name: Puppet-on-a-String
skills.description:
Angela launches a <font color="a6aafb">Puppet String</font> at the target enemy (excluding minions), dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and gradually slowing them by up to 80%. If the enemy is still connected to the string after 3s, they'll be immobilized for 1.5s and take 450<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.

Each stack of <font color="a6aafb">Lover's Mark</font> increases the final damage by 20%.

skills.name: Heartguard
skills.description:
Angela begins channeling, applying a 600<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> shield to the target allied hero regardless of distance. <font color="a6aafb">Once attached to an ally, the shield remains until detached.</font> After the channeling is complete, she attaches herself to the allied hero for 20s, <font color="a6aafb">during which she can cast skills at zero Mana cost</font>.
Angela can cast this skill again to cancel the channeling or detach herself from the allied hero. The attaching state will end early if the allied hero is killed.

skills.name: Mecha Suppression
skills.description: Each time Jawhead deals damage to an enemy hero or a Creep, he inflicts a stack of Mecha Suppression on them for 3s (up to 6 stacks). Each stack of Mecha Suppression increases all damage dealt to the target by 2% (limited to 50% for Creeps).

skills.name: Smart Missiles
skills.description: Jawhead launches up to 12 missiles at random nearby enemies over 5s, each missile dealing 135<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the enemy hit.

skills.name: Ejector
skills.description:
Jawhead gains 30% Movement Speed and a 500<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> shield for 5s.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Jawhead flings the nearest unit (prioritizes heroes) to the target location, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and stunning them for 0.5s. Can be used on allied heroes and they will not take damage.

skills.name: Unstoppable Force
skills.description: Jawhead charges into the target enemy hero, dealing 350<font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and briefly stunning them. Enemies around the target are knocked back and dealt the same amount of damage. Jawhead is immune to control effects during the charge.

skills.name: Lethal Shot
skills.description:
If Lesley doesn't take damage for 5s, her next Basic Attack gains extra range and 50% Crit Chance and deals 100<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> (20% extra damage against minions).
Each point of fixed Physical Penetration and each 1% Physical Penetration Lesley acquires is converted into 1% Crit Damage, but her base Crit Damage is reduced to 130%.
Lesley's Basic Attack restores 5 points of energy and her <font color="a6aafb">Lethal Shot</font> doubles the amount of energy restored. The <font color="a6aafb">Lethal Shot</font> effect will activate immediately after Lesley uses a skill.

skills.name: Master of Camouflage
skills.description:
Lesley enters the <font color="a6aafb">Camouflage</font> state, gaining double Energy Regen, 40% extra Movement Speed, and 85 extra <font color="fba51f"><1020></font>.
The state lasts 3s or until Lesley takes or deals damage. Enemies can detect Lesley's position through distortions of their surroundings.

skills.name: Tactical Grenade
skills.description:
Lesley throws a tactical grenade in the target direction while jumping back slightly, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area and knocking them back.

Lesley can cast this skill during <font color="a6aafb">Ultimate Snipe</font> to cancel the state and immediately fire a Fatal Bullet at the target. The attack is only triggered when there are unfired Fatal Bullets left.

skills.name: Ultimate Snipe
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Lesley's Crit Chance is increased by 10%.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Lesley locks onto an enemy hero and fires 4 Fatal Bullets in succession. Each bullet deals 250<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> (+ 5% of the target's <font color="26e407">lost <1997></font>) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and restores 10 Energy on hit. Bullets can be blocked by other enemy heroes.

If this skill is interrupted, each remaining bullet reduces this skill's cooldown by 10%.

skills.name: Spiritual Unity
skills.description: Every 5s to 8s (scales with <font color="a6aafb">Feathered Air Strike</font> level), Verri enters the <font color="a6aafb">Hunting</font> state. On Pharsa's next attack against an enemy hero, Verri deals extra <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to 8% of the target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font> (+ 1% per 200 <font color="62f8fe"><1030></font>) and slows them by 60% for 1s.

skills.name: Curse of Crow
skills.description:
Pharsa unleashes a blast of magic at the target location, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and marking them for 4s.

When Pharsa hits a marked enemy with a Basic Attack or active skill, the mark is consumed, stunning them for 1s.

Marked enemies will have their positions revealed.

skills.name: Energy Impact
skills.description: Pharsa releases magic energy in the target direction, dealing 475<font color="62f8fe"> (+145% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit.

skills.name: Feathered Air Strike
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Each level-up reduces <font color="a6aafb">Spiritual Unity</font>'s interval by 1s.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Pharsa takes flight for 8s and bombards the target area, dealing 530<font color="62f8fe"> (+160% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within. This skill can be cast up to 4 times during the flight.

skills.name: Wings by Wings
skills.description:
Pharsa turns into mist and wraps around Verri, gaining 150% extra Movement Speed (decays over time) and the ability to fly over terrain for 5s.

This state ends immediately when she is controlled or uses a Basic Attack or skill.

skills.name: Shadow of Styx
skills.description:
Helcurt remains in <font color="a6aafb">Prowler</font> state until spotted by the enemy team, gaining 15% extra Movement Speed, and continuously regenerating <font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> HP if he has not dealt any damage.
He gains 50% extra Attack Speed and 50% extra Movement Speed (decreasing over time) for 4s upon being spotted and leaves <font color="a6aafb">Prowler</font> state 0.75s later.
Any hero killed after being hit by Helcurt leaves a <font color="a6aafb">dark fog</font> that explodes and spreads with a cooldown of 10s. Helcurt <font color="a6aafb">Conceals</font> himself while within the <font color="a6aafb">dark fog</font>.

skills.name: Hidden Terror
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: When Helcurt is in the <font color="a6aafb">Prowler</font> state, <font color="a6aafb">Terrify</font> also affects enemy heroes hit and briefly reveals them. Its cooldown decreases 3 times as fast as normal.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Helcurt blinks to the target location and deals 150<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area, reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 0.75s.

skills.name: Deadly Stinger
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Helcurt gains 1 <font color="a6aafb">Deadly Stinger</font> for every 1.5s spent in <font color="a6aafb">Prowler</font> state or on each Basic Attack. Up to 5 <font color="a6aafb">Deadly Stingers</font> can be stored.

<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Helcurt fires all <font color="a6aafb">Deadly Stingers</font> forward, each dealing 180<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies (minions and creeps take only 70% of the damage).
<font color="a6aafb">Deadly Stinger</font> counts as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.

skills.name: Dark Night Falls
skills.description:
Helcurt summons the Dark Night, reducing all enemies' sight range and blocking ally vision sharing for 3s. During Dark Night, Helcurt gains 40% extra Movement Speed.

The Dark Night makes it easier for Helcurt to leave enemies' sight range.

skills.name: Decimation
skills.description: Upon death, Zhask summons a frenzied <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font> on the spot, which gradually loses HP over time until death.

skills.name: Nightmaric Spawn
skills.description:
Zhask summons a <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font> that inherits 55% of his <font color="26e407"><1005></font>, <font color="26e407"><1999></font>, and <font color="62f8fe"><1030></font>. It automatically fires <font color="a6aafb">Death Ray</font> at nearby enemies, dealing 55 (+ <font color="62f8fe">20%<1030></font>) (+ <font color="26e407">20% Extra Attack Speed</font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slowing them by up to 30%. It disappears when Zhask moves too far away.

<font color="a6aafb">Death Ray</font> is considered a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.

<font color="a6aafb">Fusion Enhanced</font>: <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font> deals 180% damage and can be repositioned.

skills.name: Mind Eater
skills.description:
Zhask fires a penetrating psychic beam in the target direction, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. Afterward, the <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font> attacks enemies hit by <font color="a6aafb">Mind Eater</font>, dealing 120<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and stunning them for 0.5s.

<font color="a6aafb">Fusion Enhanced</font>: <font color="a6aafb">Mind Eater</font> damage is increased to 540<font color="62f8fe"> (+180% Total Magic Power)</font>.

skills.name: Hive Clones
skills.description:
Zhask releases a swarm of <font color="a6aafb">Hive Clones</font> in the target direction. The clones explode upon hitting an enemy, dealing 55<font color="62f8fe"> (+18% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and reducing their Movement Speed by 80% for 1s.
If the <font color="a6aafb">Hive Clones</font> hit no target, they burrow into the ground to ambush passing enemies.

<font color="a6aafb">Fusion Enhanced</font>: Zhask releases several swarms of <font color="a6aafb">Hive Clones</font>.
Subsequent damage to the same target decays to 20%.

skills.name: Dominator's Descent
skills.description:
Zhask selects a target area to summon an enhanced <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font> and fuses with it. <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font> can inherit 100% of his attributes and get extra attributes. His skills are enhanced during the fusion period.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Zhask immediately gets off the <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font> and loses enhancement.

skills.name: Thickened Blood
skills.description:
Hylos gains 1 extra Max Mana for every 2.5 <font color="26e407">Extra <1005></font> gained.
When out of Mana, he can consume HP to cast skills.

skills.name: Law and Order
skills.description:
Hylos gains 50% Movement Speed and causes his next Basic Attack within 3s to deal 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the target, knocking back and stunning them for 1s.

<font color="A4AAC7">The extra Movement Speed rapidly decays over the duration and vanishes after the next Basic Attack.</font>

skills.name: Ring of Punishment
skills.description:
Hylos releases the <font color="a6aafb">Ring of Punishment</font>, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+20% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies per second while slowing them by 4% and reducing their Attack Speed by 7.5% for 2.5s (up to 8 stacks). Each stack also increases the enemy's damage taken from the <font color="a6aafb">Ring of Punishment</font> by 5%. The <font color="a6aafb">Ring of Punishment</font> consumes 30 Mana per second when it's active.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Hylos cancels the <font color="a6aafb">Ring of Punishment</font>.

skills.name: Glorious Pathway
skills.description:
Hylos creates a huge pathway in the target direction, reducing enemies' Movement Speed by 75% for 1s. The pathway lasts 6s.
When on the pathway, Hylos gains Slow Immunity and recovers 3% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> per second. Allied heroes moving along the pathway gain 60% extra Movement Speed, while enemy heroes on the pathway will be slowed by 25%.

skills.name: Young Again
skills.description: Upon death, Diggie reverses time and returns to egg form, allowing him to move and use a new set of skills. He is untargetable in egg form and revives at his current location.

skills.name: Auto Alarm Bomb
skills.description:
Diggie flings an owl alarm to the target location that remains stationary for 25s or until it reacts to the first enemy in range, chasing them and exploding upon collision. The explosion deals 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and slows them by 30%.

Diggie gains 2 stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Dangerous Sparks</font> each time an enemy hero is hit by the explosion (up to 60 stacks), each stack increasing the skill's damage by 1%. He loses half the stacks upon death, but can gain 1 stack of <font color="a6aafb">Dangerous Sparks</font> each time his skill hits an enemy hero when in egg form.

Up to 5 owl alarms can exist at the same time.

skills.name: Reverse Time
skills.description:
Diggie marks the target enemy hero for 4s and pulls them back to their previous location after the duration ends, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and briefly slowing them by 80%.

If the enemy moves out of the circle, the pull will be triggered early.

skills.name: Time Journey
skills.description: Diggie removes all debuffs on nearby allied heroes (including himself) and grants them a 650<font color="62f8fe"> (+300% Total Magic Power)</font> shield and Control Immunity for 2s. He also gains 50% Movement Speed for 0.5s.

skills.name: Soul Cutter
skills.description: Each time Lancelot charges, his damage is increased by 7.5% for 4s, up to 30%.

skills.name: Puncture
skills.description:
Lancelot charges in the target direction, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in his path and marking the first unmarked enemy hit with <font color="a6aafb">Sword Mark</font> for 3s.

If a new <font color="a6aafb">Sword Mark</font> is applied, this skill's cooldown resets.

skills.name: Thorned Rose
skills.description: Lancelot strikes in the target direction 3 times, each time dealing 220<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit (damage is reduced when multiple enemies are hit). He's untargetable during this process. Enemies in the center of the area take all the 3 hits and are slowed by 20% for 0.5s. The slow effect can stack.

skills.name: Phantom Execution
skills.description: After a short delay, Lancelot performs an executioner's strike in the target direction, dealing 350<font color="fba51f"> (+170% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit. He is invincible throughout the process.

skills.name: Lakeshore Ambience
skills.description:
For 8s after casting a skill, Odette's next Basic Attack gains extra range and bounces between enemies (or an enemy and herself), dealing 144-200<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> per hit.

Odette's skills also trigger this effect on hit (up to 3 stacks).

skills.name: Avian Authority
skills.description: Odette releases a magic swan in the target direction, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s.

skills.name: Blue Nova
skills.description:
Odette releases a group of magic orbs in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.5s.

When an orb hits an enemy, it creates another orb that attacks a nearby enemy, prioritizing enemy heroes, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and immobilizing them for 1.5s.

skills.name: Swan Song
skills.description:
Odette channels a dance, gaining a 1200<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> shield and dealing up to 2000<font color="62f8fe"> (+750% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies in a large area for 5s. During this time, her Movement Speed is reduced by 40%, but she can move freely.

<font color="A4AAC7">Use again to cancel. Only high-level control effects can interrupt this skill.</font>

skills.name: Warmonger
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Malice Energy</font> grants Argus an initial Crit Chance of 30%. Instead of dealing normal critical damage, Argus's Crits are converted into <font color="a6aafb">Demonic Slash</font>, which ignores 30% of the target's <font color="fba51f"><1060></font>, deals 90<font color="fba51f"> (+25% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target, and recovers 140 HP.

<font color="a6aafb">Demonic Slash</font> cannot Crit, but can still trigger Crit-related effects.

skills.name: Demonic Grip
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">First Cast</font>: Argus extends a demonic hand in the target direction, dealing 125<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hero or creep hit and stunning them for 0.7s. Argus and the target are pulled toward each other, and the target is slowed by 40% for 2s. If no enemy is hit, Argus is pulled to the hand's endpoint instead.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Argus dashes forward and performs a wide slash, dealing 175<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area.

skills.name: Meteoric Sword
skills.description:
After a short charge, Argus thrusts his <font color="a6aafb">Meteoric Sword</font> in the target direction, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target.
If this hits an enemy hero, Argus stuns them for 0.3s and gains 30% Attack Speed for 3s. Meteoric Sword's damage also gains a 40% boost to Crit Chance and Crit Damage.

<font color="a6aafb">Meteoric Sword</font> counts as a Basic Attack and can trigger Attack Effects. Attack Speed shortens the charge time.

skills.name: Eternal Evil
skills.description:
Argus removes all control effects, gains <font color="a6aafb">Death Immunity</font> for 4s, and deals 150<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies. This damage increases as Argus's <font color="26e407">Current <1005></font> decreases, reaching 150% when it falls below 30%. When <font color="a6aafb">Death Immunity</font> ends, Argus recovers HP equal to all damage dealt to enemy heroes during its duration.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: If Argus takes fatal damage while <font color="a6aafb">Eternal Evil</font> is not on cooldown, he removes all control effects and automatically enters <font color="a6aafb">Death Immunity</font> without triggering AOE Damage.

skills.name: Bastion of Stone
skills.description:
Grock gains a shield equal to 14% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> and empowers the next Basic Attack to deal 4<font color="26e407"> (+2% Total Physical Defense)</font>% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> (capped at 300<font color="ffe63c"> (+20*Hero Level)</font> against non-hero units). Cooldown: 18s - 12s (decreases with level). This cooldown is reduced by 200% when near terrain.
Grock's skills cannot be interrupted, and he gains 30<font color="ffe63c"> (+6*Hero Level)</font>% extra <font color="fba51f"><1060></font> while the shield is active.

skills.name: Mighty Swing
skills.description: Grock strikes forward with massive force, dealing 240<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. Enemies with obstacles behind them are knocked back into the obstacle, knocked airborne, and take 4<font color="26e407"> (+2% Total Physical Defense)</font>% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> (capped at 300<font color="ffe63c"> (+20*Hero Level)</font> against non-hero units). If there are no obstacles behind, enemies are only knocked back slightly.

skills.name: Earthen Rampart
skills.description:
After a brief delay, Grock summons a stone wall in the target area, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and knocking enemies towards him.
<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Cancel the wall early.

skills.name: Tectonic Charge
skills.description: Grock charges forward and gains Control Immunity, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in his path. Upon hitting terrain, he immediately stops and triggers a massive explosion that knocks nearby enemies airborne for 1s and deals 650<font color="fba51f"> (+300% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. If this skill doesn't hit terrain, 50% of its cooldown is refunded.

skills.name: Jungle Heart
skills.description:
Irithel and Leo's immaculate teamwork allows her to shoot while moving. Each Basic Attack will shoot 2 crossbow bolt(s) (but takes longer to refill) that deal <font color="fba51f"> (+55% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> per bolt (inherits a portion of Attack Effects).
Moving will build up <font color="a6aafb">Jungle Heart</font>, up to a maximum of 10 units, and cause the next Basic Attack to unleash 1 additional bolt(s).

skills.name: Strafe
skills.description: Irithel launches a volley of arrows on the target area, dealing 330<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies within and reducing their <font color="fba51f"><1060></font> by 15 for 3s.

skills.name: Force of The Queen
skills.description: Leo lets out a piercing roar, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 40% for 2s.

skills.name: Heavy Crossbow
skills.description:
Irithel commands Leo to leap in the target direction and empowers her crossbow for 10s.
During this time, she gains 30 Movement Speed, generates <font color="a6aafb">Jungle Heart</font> faster, and fires heavy bolts with her Basic Attacks, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+65% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target and nearby units.

skills.name: Magic Master
skills.description:
Harley's mastery of magic allows his Basic Attacks and skills to reduce the enemy's <font color="62f8fe"><1070></font> by 2 and increase his Attack Speed by 5% - 10% (scales with hero level) for 3s on hit. This effect stacks up to 10 times.
Harley's Basic Attacks deal 60<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="62f8fe">(+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.

skills.name: Poker Trick
skills.description:
Harley throws 3 waves of cards, 3 cards per wave. Each card deals 120<font color="62f8fe"> (+25% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies.
After the same target is hit 3 time(s), the damage will decay to 50% on subsequent hits.

skills.name: Space Escape
skills.description:
Harley blinks in the designated direction, leaving a magic hat at his starting location. His Movement Speed increases by 60% for 2s, then rapidly decays to normal over 4s.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Return to the hat's location.

skills.name: Deadly Magic
skills.description: Harley casts a magic ring of fire at an enemy hero, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and a 40% slow effect that decays to 15% after 1.5s. The ring will stay around the target, during which Harley can hit the ring to damage the target. The ring will explode after 4s, dealing <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> plus 30% of the damage taken by the target while the ring was active.

skills.name: Steel Bones
skills.description:
Gatotkaca gains <font color="fba51f"><1060></font> equal to 2% of his lost HP (up to 200). He gains 5 Rage (up to 100) for every 300 damage taken (calculated before reduction).

Upon reaching 25 Rage, Gatotkaca's next Basic Attack is enhanced, consuming all Rage to deal <font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="62f8fe"> (+200% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 8.2-11 * <font color="a6aafb">Consumed Rage</font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> (scales with hero level) and recover (8 * <font color="a6aafb">Consumed Rage</font>) HP.

skills.name: Blast Iron Fist
skills.description: Gatotkaca slams the ground, creating a shattered zone in the target direction while dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within. Enemies in the shattered zone will take 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+20% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> per second and be slowed by 30%.

skills.name: Unbreakable
skills.description: Gatotkaca begins channeling, then sprints in the target direction with a battle cry, taunting enemies on the path to attack him, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> for 0.9 - 1.5s. The taunt duration and sprint distance scale with the channel time. Canceling the skill reduces 50% of the remaining cooldown.

skills.name: Avatar of the Guardian
skills.description:
Gatotkaca jumps to the target location, dealing 500<font color="62f8fe"> (+300% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for 1s. Enemies near the center of the area will be knocked airborne for a longer duration, while enemies on the fringes will be pulled to the center.

The camera will move with the skill indicator but won't grant extra sight.

skills.name: Lightwheel Mark
skills.description:
Karrie's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Lightwheel Mark</font> on hit.
Once a target has 5 stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Lightwheel Marks</font>, the marks will turn into a lightwheel, dealing <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> equal to 5 of the target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font> to them (only up to 5 damage against creeps).

skills.name: Spinning Lightwheel
skills.description: Karrie releases a sphere of surging energy in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path. The sphere will stop upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its max travel distance, continuously dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+10% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 80% for 1s.

skills.name: Phantom Step
skills.description:
Karrie dashes in the target direction while throwing a lightwheel at the nearest enemy, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and applying a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Lightwheel Mark</font> on them.

When in <font color="a6aafb">Dual Wield</font> state, Karrie throws two lightwheels instead.

skills.name: Speedy Lightwheel
skills.description: Karrie enters <font color="a6aafb">Dual Wield</font> state for 10s, gaining 30% Movement Speed. Each Basic Attack deals 50<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and throws 2 lightwheels that inherit a portion of Attack Effects.

skills.name: Full Moon Curse
skills.description:
Roger can freely switch between human and wolf forms.
In human form, Roger's attack deals extra damage equal to 4% of the target's <font color="26e407">current <1005></font>. In wolf form, his attack deals extra damage equal to 4% of the target's [lost C6<1997>].
Extra damage against creeps is capped at 60.

skills.name: Open Fire
skills.description:
Roger fires two quick shots in the target direction, dealing a total of 250<font color="fba51f"> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the enemy hit.
The first shot is a hunter net that slows the enemy by 80% for 1.5s.
The second is a bullet that reduces the enemy's <font color="fba51f"><1060></font> by 10 for 5s.

skills.name: Hunter's Steps
skills.description: Roger gains 20% Movement Speed and 20% Attack Speed for 2.5s.

skills.name: Wolf Transformation
skills.description:
Roger lunges in the target direction and turns into wolf form, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 90% for 0.8s.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: In wolf form, Roger gains 20 <font color="26e407"><1999></font> and 25 Movement Speed.

skills.name: Full Moon Curse
skills.description:
Roger can freely switch between human and wolf forms.
In human form, Roger's attack deals extra damage equal to 4% of the target's <font color="26e407">current <1005></font>. In wolf form, his attack deals extra damage equal to 4% of the target's [lost C6<1997>].
Extra damage against creeps is capped at 60.

skills.name: Lycan Pounce
skills.description:
Roger lunges at the target enemy, becoming untargetable while dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to up to 3 enemies in the area.

Getting a kill or assist will reduce the cooldown of this skill by 80%.

skills.name: Bloodthirsty Howl
skills.description: Roger lets out a howl, increasing his Attack Speed by 1.15 times for 5s and revealing nearby enemy heroes with HP below 40%. If there are enemy heroes with HP below 40% in range, Roger gains 50% Movement Speed.

skills.name: Restore Human Form
skills.description: Roger rolls in the target direction and reverts back to human form, gaining a 200<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> shield for 1.5s.

skills.name: Nether Touch
skills.description:
Vexana and her <font color="a6aafb">Eternal Guard</font> inflict <font color="a6aafb">Nether Touch</font> on enemies hit.

The mark lasts 5s and causes the affected enemy to explode upon death, dealing 108-500<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies (base damage scales with level).

skills.name: Deathly Grasp
skills.description: Vexana unleashes a <font color="a6aafb">Deathly Grasp</font> in the target direction, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in its path. It stops upon hitting an enemy hero, <font color="a6aafb">Terrifying</font> and knocking them back. After a short delay, it explodes, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and <font color="a6aafb">Terrifying</font> them for 1s.

skills.name: Cursed Blast
skills.description: Vexana marks the target area with the power of the undead, striking it after a 0.8s delay and dealing 580<font color="62f8fe"> (+165% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit.

skills.name: Eternal Guard
skills.description: Vexana summons an <font color="a6aafb">Eternal Guard</font> at the target location, dealing 480<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.8s. The <font color="a6aafb">Eternal Guard</font> then joins Vexana in battle for 15s. Its attacks deal 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 5% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and Splash Damage in a large area.

skills.name: Homeland Defender
skills.description:
Lapu-Lapu gains 10 <font color="a6aafb">Bravery Blessing</font> each time he deals damage (halved against non-hero units).

At max <font color="a6aafb">Bravery Blessing</font> stacks, he dashes toward the target with his next <font color="a6aafb">Basic Attack</font>, dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> (cannot Crit) and granting him a 250 (+65*Hero Level) shield for 2.5s.

skills.name: Justice Blades
skills.description:
Lapu-Lapu releases two boomerangs in the target direction, each boomerang dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit on its way out and back.
