<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Hitting an enemy allows Natalia to recast this skill within 5s.

skills.name: Smoke Bomb
skills.description: Natalia releases a <font color="a6aafb">Smoke Bomb</font> at her location, slowing enemies within by 25% while Natalia becomes immune to enemy Basic Attacks for 4s.

skills.name: The Hunt
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Natalia gains 15% Crit Chance.

<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Natalia immediately enters the <font color="a6aafb">Assassin Instinct</font> state. She can store up to 2 Ultimate charges, and each charge has a recharge time of 30s. Killing creeps reduces the remaining recharge time by 50% of the full recharge time.

skills.name: Mystic Favor
skills.description: After Gord hits the same target 4 times with skills in quick succession, his next skill deals 120 (+8*Hero Level) <font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> extra <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> and slows them by 20% for 1s (the slow effect stacks up to 2 times).

skills.name: Mystic Projectile
skills.description: Gord conjures a Mystic Orb that bounces in the target direction and explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 225<font color="62f8fe"> (+65% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in the area, while stunning them and revealing their locations for 1s.

skills.name: Mystic Injunction
skills.description: Gord creates an energy field in the target area, dealing 30<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> every 0.25s to enemies within (up to 16 times).

skills.name: Mystic Gush
skills.description:
Gord unleashes an energy beam in the target direction, dealing 90<font color="62f8fe"> (+32% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit every 0.2s (up to 16 times).

The direction of the beam can be adjusted using the Joystick.

skills.name: Power of Einherjar
skills.description:
Freya gains 1 <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Orb</font> stack(s) with each Basic Attack (up to 6 stacks). Consuming 1 stack(s) of <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Orb</font> grants Freya 100% Attack Speed for her next Basic Attack and recovers 20 (+3*Hero Level)<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> HP (up to 6 stacks).

While out of combat, <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Orb</font> stacks are gradually restored.

skills.name: Leap of Faith
skills.description: Freya leaps to the target area and strikes the ground with her shield, gaining 500<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> shield and dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies within while knocking them airborne for 0.4s.

skills.name: Valkyrie Slash
skills.description:
Freya charges forward and slashes, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing enemies by 30% for 0.5s. This skill has no base cooldown but consumes 2 <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Orbs</font> per cast.

This skill deals 50% damage to creeps.

skills.name: Valkyrie Descent
skills.description:
Freya dives toward the target area, gaining Control Immunity. She deals 300<font color="fba51f"> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along her path and in the landing area. Enemies hit are slowed by 40% for 2s.
Upon landing, Freya enters the <font color="a6aafb">Valkyrie</font> state for 10s and gains 30 Movement Speed. Her Basic Attacks deal 100<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> Splash Damage (only the bonus Physical Damage can Crit).

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Trace of Shadow
skills.description: Hayabusa's attacks apply a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Mark</font> on hit (up to 4 stacks). Each stack lasts 6s and increases Hayabusa's damage to the enemy by 5%.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Hayabusa permanently gains 3% Spell Vamp.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Hayabusa throws three returning shurikens in the target direction, each dealing 220<font color="fba51f"> (+75% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 35% for 2s. Subsequent hits on the same enemy deal 70% less damage (only 50% less to creeps). He also restores 10 Energy when hitting non-minion enemies.

skills.name: Ninjutsu: Quad Shadow
skills.description:
Hayabusa dashes in the target direction and releases four phantoms that travel in separate directions. The phantoms will remain at the end of their paths or attach themselves to the first enemy hero hit, dealing 130<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing them by 40% for 2s. Hayabusa will immediately stop if he hits an enemy hero during the dash.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Hayabusa teleports to a phantom's location and reduces the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken</font> by 1s. If the phantom is attached to an enemy hero, he also deals 130<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the enemy.

skills.name: Ougi: Shadow Kill
skills.description:
Hayabusa blends into the shadows and launches 6 single-target attacks on enemies in the area, each dealing 130<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

The attacks prioritize enemies with <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Mark</font> and each will consume a mark to deal 90<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Extra Physical Attack)</font> extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. Shadow Kill does not apply <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Mark</font>.

skills.name: Noumenon Energy Core
skills.description: Every 6s to 3s (scales with <font color="a6aafb">Noumenon Blast</font> level), the Noumenon Energy Core grants Lolita 20<font color="26e407"> (+2.5% Max HP)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+20% Total Magic Power)</font> shield. When Lolita casts a skill, the Noumenon Energy Core grants Lolita and nearby allied heroes an extra shield. This shield can stack up to 3 times and lasts 30s.

skills.name: Power Charge
skills.description: Lolita dashes in the target direction. Her next Basic Attack within 4s will perform a short dash to the target, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and stunning them for 0.5s. This damage is doubled against Minions.

skills.name: Guardian's Reflection
skills.description:
Lolita raises her shield and reflects all incoming ranged Basic Attacks and <font color="a6aafb">Projectiles</font> in the direction of the shield for 3s. The shield will break after taking 1000<font color="26e407"> (+15% Max HP)</font> damage.

The damage and effects from the Unique Passives of an attacker's equipment will not apply to the shield and will not be reflected. This skill can be interrupted by high level control effects.

skills.name: Noumenon Blast
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Reduces the interval of <font color="a6aafb">Noumenon Energy Core</font> by 1s each time this skill is upgraded.

<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Lolita begins charging for 2s while slowing enemies in a fan-shaped area by 60%. When the charging is complete or is stopped, Lolita slams her hammer on the ground, dealing up to 600<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and stunning them for up to 2s (damage and stun duration scale with charge time).

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Lolita immediately stops charging and slams her hammer on the ground.

skills.name: Rage Incarnate
skills.description:
After casting a skill, Minotaur gains <font color="a6aafb">Motivation</font>, recovering HP equal to 5 (+1*Hero Level)% of damage taken from enemy heroes for 3s.

<font color="a6aafb">Enraged State</font>: <font color="a6aafb">Motivation</font> HP recovery is increased to 200%.

skills.name: Despair Stomp
skills.description:
Minotaur jumps to the target location, dealing 325<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and briefly knocking them airborne. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 40% while Minotaur enhances his Basic Attacks to deal 25<font color="26e407"> (+5% Max HP)</font> extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> for 2s.

<font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font>: Increases the AOE range and the damage dealt by 25<font color="26e407"> (+5% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

skills.name: Motivation Roar
skills.description:
Minotaur heals himself and the nearby ally with the lowest HP, recovering 220<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> HP for both. He also recovers an additional 8% of his <font color="26e407">lost <1997></font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font>: Minotaur heals himself and all nearby allied heroes.

skills.name: Minoan Fury
skills.description:
Minotaur enters <font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font> state and smashes the ground 3 times. The first 2 hits deal 180<font color="fba51f"> (+85% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slow them by 60%, while the final hit deals 200<font color="ffe63c"> (+85% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> and knocks targets airborne for 0.8s. Minotaur is immune to control effects during this attack.

The <font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font> state lasts 12s and enhances Minotaur's skills for the duration.

skills.name: Malefic Gun
skills.description: Layla's damage increases with distance, from 100% to 115% at 6 units or farther. This effect does not apply to Turrets.

skills.name: Malefic Bomb
skills.description:
Layla fires a <font color="a6aafb">Malefic Bomb</font> in the target direction, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hit (can Crit).

If <font color="a6aafb">Malefic Bomb</font> hits an enemy, Layla's Basic Attacks and <font color="a6aafb">Void Projectile</font> gain extra range for 3s. She also gains 60% Movement Speed that decays over 1.2s. The Movement Speed boost lasts twice as long if an enemy hero is hit.

skills.name: Void Projectile
skills.description:
Layla fires an orb of Malefic Energy at the target, dealing 170<font color="fba51f"> (+65% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target and nearby enemies and applying a <font color="a6aafb">Magic Mark</font> to the target for 3s.
When Layla hits an enemy with a <font color="a6aafb">Magic Mark</font>, she deals 100<font color="fba51f"> (+35% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target and nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.25s.

skills.name: Destruction Rush
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: The range of <font color="a6aafb">Void Projectile</font> and Basic Attacks is increased by 0.6 units. Layla's sight range is slightly increased each time this skill is upgraded. 
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Layla fires a blast of Malefic Energy in the target direction, dealing 500<font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a line.

skills.name: Air Superiority
skills.description:
While flying, Fanny deals 10%-20% extra damage to enemies hit based on her flying speed and applies 1 stack of <font color="a6aafb">Prey Mark</font> with each hit (up to 2 stacks).

Her subsequent skill hits on marked enemy heroes restore 8 energy per stack. Energy restoration is reduced when multiple enemy heroes are hit within a short period.

skills.name: Tornado Strike
skills.description: Fanny whirls her blades, dealing 275<font color="fba51f"> (+85% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Steel Cable
skills.description:
Fanny shoots a cable in the target direction, pulling herself toward the first obstacle it hits. She can recast this skill within 2s as long as she has enough energy. Each successive cast during this period costs 2 less energy.

While flying, Fanny automatically casts <font color="a6aafb">Tornado Strike</font> when she hits an enemy if she has enough Energy.

skills.name: Cut Throat
skills.description: Fanny leaps at the target enemy hero or Creep with her blades, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. Each stack of <font color="a6aafb">Prey Mark</font> on the target increases this damage by 30%.

skills.name: Dragon Flurry
skills.description:
After dealing damage 3 time(s) with Basic Attacks or skills, Zilong triggers <font color="a6aafb">Dragon Flurry</font> on the next Basic Attack, hitting the target 3 time(s). Each hit deals 80<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> Basic Attack Damage and heals himself for 50<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> HP.

Zilong's Basic Attack deals 100<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

If the target's HP is below 50%, all damage dealt by Zilong's skills and Basic Attacks is increased by 30.

skills.name: Spear Flip
skills.description: Zilong flings the target enemy over his head, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

skills.name: Spear Strike
skills.description:
Zilong lunges at the target enemy, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and reducing their <font color="fba51f"><1060></font> by 15 for 2s.

The cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Spear Strike</font> is reset each time Zilong kills an enemy.

skills.name: Supreme Warrior
skills.description:
Zilong removes all slow effects on himself and gains 40% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, and Slow Immunity for 7.5s.

During this time, <font color="a6aafb">Dragon Flurry</font> triggers every 2 attacks (instead of the previous 3).

skills.name: Divine Resurrection
skills.description:
Rafaela can cast a special skill every 10s. After channeling for 2.5s, she instantly resurrects an ally and increases their Movement Speed by 30% for 5s (taking damage from heroes and Legend Creeps interrupts channeling and puts the skill on base cooldown).
This skill's cooldown is increased by 600% of the target's remaining respawn time, capped at 240s. This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

skills.name: Light of Retribution
skills.description: Rafaela strikes the three nearest enemies with <font color="a6aafb">Light of Retribution</font>, dealing them 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, briefly revealing their positions, and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s. Enemies hit by <font color="a6aafb">Light of Retribution</font> again within 6s will take 20% extra damage (this effect stacks up to 3 times).

skills.name: Holy Healing
skills.description:
Rafaela calls upon Holy Light, recovering 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+35% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to nearby allied heroes, plus an additional 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+65% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to herself and the most injured allied hero in range. She also increases the Movement Speed of nearby allied heroes by 30% and grants Slow Immunity for 1s.
Every 10 <font color="62f8fe"><1030></font> increases the Movement Speed bonus by 1%.

skills.name: Holy Baptism
skills.description: Rafaela unleashes the true power of <font color="a6aafb">Holy Light</font> in the target direction, dealing 460<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in a line and stunning them for 1.2s.

skills.name: Double Shot
skills.description: After each skill cast, Clint's next Basic Attack within 4s penetrates a line of enemies, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. This damage can trigger Attack Effects, and the part affected by <font color="fba51f"><1020></font> can Crit.

skills.name: Quick Draw
skills.description:
Clint rapidly fires 5 bullets in the target direction, each dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+85% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the enemy hit.
The bullets spread evenly across a fan-shaped area. Enemies hit by multiple bullets take reduced damage from each bullet after the first.

skills.name: Trapping Recoil
skills.description:
Clint shoots a trap net in the target direction, slightly jumping back while dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font><font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

Successfully hitting an enemy reduces the cooldown of this skill by 40%.

skills.name: Grenade Bombardment
skills.description:
Clint launches a grenade in the target direction that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 280<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing them by 50% for 0.5s.

Clint gains a grenade charge every 10s (up to 3).

skills.name: Mecha Legs
skills.description:
Bruno gains 2.5% extra Crit Chance each time he deals damage with his skills (up to 8 stacks).

Bruno has higher Physical Attack but only gains 80% extra Attack Speed from all sources.

skills.name: Volley Shot
skills.description:
Bruno kicks a <font color="a6aafb">Powerball</font> on his next Basic Attack, gaining 1 Movement Speed for 48%s. It deals 75<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target, and slows them by 30% for 0.5s.

The <font color="a6aafb">Powerball</font> then bounces back toward Bruno and lands on the ground. He or allied heroes can retrieve the <font color="a6aafb">Powerball</font> for another attack and reduce the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Slide</font> by 1s.

skills.name: Slide
skills.description: Bruno slides forward, briefly stunning enemies along the way, and gaining a Powerball at the end of the dash.

skills.name: Worldie
skills.description:
Bruno kicks an <font color="a6aafb">Energy Ball</font> at a target hero, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>. It knocks them back to the edge of Bruno's attack range, stuns them for 0.5s, and slows them by 80% for 2s.

The <font color="a6aafb">Energy Ball</font> then bounces among enemy units (up to 10 times), prioritizing enemy heroes. Each bounce deals 100<font color="fba51f"> (+40% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

skills.name: Shark Bite
skills.description: Bane infuses his weapon with a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Power of Tide</font> each time he uses a skill (up to 2 stacks). Each of his subsequent Basic Attacks consumes a stack to deal <font color="fba51f"> (+95% Total Physical Attack)</font> (+ 4 (+0.4*Hero Level)% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Crab Claw Cannon
skills.description:
Bane fires his Crab Claw Cannon in the target direction, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+160% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hit and then 150% damage to a random enemy behind them (prioritizes enemy heroes). Enemies hit are slowed by 10<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font>% for 1s.
Every 100 <font color="fba51f"><1020></font> Bane possesses reduces this skill's cooldown by an additional 8%.

skills.name: Sea Ink
skills.description:
Bane swallows a cup of sea ink, recovering HP equal to 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> + 5<font color="62f8fe"> (+1.5% Total Magic Power)</font>% of his <font color="26e407"><1998></font>, and gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Bane spits corrosive ink in a fan-shaped area, dealing 140<font color="62f8fe"> (+130% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> (up to 200% with charging time).
Every 100 <font color="62f8fe"><1030></font> Bane possesses reduces this skill's cooldown by an additional 7%.

skills.name: Deadly Catch
skills.description:
Bane summons a school of sharks to charge in the target direction, dealing 700<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit, knocking them airborne for 0.6s, and slowing them by 75% (decays over 3s).
This skill deals 40% damage to turrets.

skills.name: Wasteland Force
skills.description:
If Franco takes no damage for 5s, he gains 10% Movement Speed, recovers 1% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> per second, and begins gaining <font color="a6aafb">Wasteland Force</font> (up to 10 stacks).
Franco's next skill consumes all <font color="a6aafb">Wasteland Force</font> stacks, increasing its damage by up to 150%.

skills.name: Iron Hook
skills.description: Franco launches an <font color="a6aafb">Iron Hook</font> in the target direction. The hook snags the first enemy unit hit, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and dragging them to him.

skills.name: Fury Shock
skills.description: Franco lashes out, dealing 300 (+ 4% of his <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies, slowing them by 70% for 1.5s.

skills.name: Bloody Hunt
skills.description: Franco suppresses the target enemy hero for 1.8s and strikes them 6 times over the duration, each time dealing 50<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

skills.name: Tai Chi
skills.description:
Akai gains a 25<font color="26e407"> (+5% Max HP)</font> shield for 4s on each skill cast.

His skills apply a <font color="a6aafb">Mark</font> to targets. His next Basic Attack against a marked target deals 35<font color="26e407"> (+6% Max HP)</font> extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

skills.name: Headbutt
skills.description:
Akai charges in the target direction, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way.

Upon hitting an enemy hero, he knocks them airborne for 0.5s and can roll once in the joystick's direction.

Akai can cast <font color="a6aafb">Headbutt</font> during <font color="a6aafb">Heavy Spin</font> to quickly reposition himself.

skills.name: Body Slam
skills.description: Akai slams his body into the ground, dealing 270<font color="26e407"> (+6% Max HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 45% for 2s.

skills.name: Heavy Spin
skills.description:
Akai spins for 4s, continuously dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Knocked-back enemy heroes also knock back any enemy heroes they collide with.

Upon casting, Akai removes all debuffs and gains slow immunity. While spinning, his Movement Speed gradually increases to 70%.

This skill can only be interrupted by <font color="a6aafb">Suppression</font>.

skills.name: Shadow Combo
skills.description:
Karina's third consecutive attack against the same enemy deals 100 (+ 5<font color="62f8fe"> (+2.5% Total Magic Power)</font>% target's <font color="26e407">Lost <1997></font>) extra <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font>.

If the target is an enemy hero, this attack also reduces the cooldowns of her non-Ultimate skills by 1.5s.
Damage dealt to creeps is capped at 2000 <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font>.

skills.name: Dance of Blades
skills.description:
Karina enters the <font color="a6aafb">Dance of Blades</font> state for up to 3.5s, gaining 45% Movement Speed and blocking all Basic Attacks. Blocked attacks trigger a counterattack that deals 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the attacker (firing a <font color="a6aafb">Shadowblade</font> at ranged attackers or triggering <font color="a6aafb">Dance of Blades</font> against melee attackers).
This effect has a 0.4s cooldown).

Casting a Basic Attack or <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Assault</font> ends the <font color="a6aafb">Dance of Blades</font> state, empowering Karina's next Basic Attack to deal 160<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> critical <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slow the target by 45% for 1s.

skills.name: Dance of Death
skills.description: Karina launches a spinning slash, dealing 375<font color="62f8fe"> (+125% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Shadow Assault
skills.description:
Karina dashes to the enemy hero, dealing 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+160% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, applying a <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Sigil</font> to the target, and leaving a <font color="a6aafb">Shadowform</font> behind them.

The <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Sigil</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Shadowform</font> both last 5s. If the target dies during this time, this skill's cooldown resets immediately.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Karina dashes back to the <font color="a6aafb">Shadowform</font>'s location, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies along the way.

skills.name: Pursuit
skills.description:
After each skill cast, Alucard's next Basic Attack allows him to dash to the target and deal <font color="fba51f"> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Demon Hunter</font>: Alucard deals 110% damage to creeps.

skills.name: Groundsplitter
skills.description: Alucard jumps to the target area and slashes, dealing 270<font color="fba51f"> (+85% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies within the area and slowing them by 40% for 2s.

skills.name: Whirling Smash
skills.description: Alucard launches a whirling slash, dealing 345<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

skills.name: Fission Wave
skills.description:
<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Alucard permanently gains 10% Hybrid Lifesteal.

<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Alucard absorbs the energy of enemies in the target area, reducing their Movement Speed by 30% and <font color="26e407"><1999></font> by 10. He gains 10 <font color="26e407"><1999></font> for each enemy hero hit and reduces the cooldown of his other skills to 50% for 6s.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Alucard releases a powerful shockwave forward, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

skills.name: Fearless
skills.description:
Tigreal gains 1 stack of <font color="a6aafb">Fearless</font> each time he is hit by a Basic Attack. At 4 stacks, he consumes them to block the next incoming Basic Attack (including attacks from Turrets).
He also gains 1 stack of <font color="a6aafb">Fearless</font> each time he casts a skill.

Damage from minions does not add or consume <font color="a6aafb">Fearless</font> stacks.

skills.name: Attack Wave
skills.description: Tigreal smashes the ground with his hammer, sending a shockwave that erupts 3 times in a fan-shaped area. Each eruption deals 270<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slows them by 20% / 40% / 60% for 1.5s.

skills.name: Sacred Hammer
skills.description:
Tigreal charges in the target direction, dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way and pushing them to the end of the charge.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Tigreal can use this skill again within 4s, dealing 280<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in front of him and knocking them airborne for 0.6s.

skills.name: Implosion
skills.description:
Tigreal unleashes the power of his hammer, pulling nearby enemies to him, dealing 600<font color="fba51f"> (+130% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and stunning them for 1.8s.

The first half of the channeling can be interrupted by control effects, while the second half can only be interrupted by <font color="a6aafb">Suppression</font>.

skills.name: Molina's Gift
skills.description:
Upon taking fatal damage, <font color="a6aafb">Molina's Gift</font> removes all debuffs from Nana and transforms her for 2s. While transformed, Nana is immune to all damage, gains 30% Movement Speed, and recovers 10% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> per second, but cannot cast skills.
This effect can trigger only once every 150s.

skills.name: Magic Boomerang
skills.description:
Nana hurls her <font color="a6aafb">Magic Boomerang</font> in the target direction, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies it hits as it travels out and returns.

The first enemy hit takes full damage. Damage is reduced by 10% each additional enemy hit, up to a maximum total reduction of 70%.

skills.name: Molina Smooch
skills.description:
Nana throws Molina at the target location, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within range and <font color="a6aafb">Transforming</font> enemy heroes hit into small animals.

If Molina does not hit an enemy hero, she will remain on the ground and chase the nearest enemy hero that comes into range, <font color="a6aafb">Transforming</font> the first enemy hero she touches.

<font color="a6aafb">Transform</font>: Reduces the target's Movement Speed by 50% and <font color="62f8fe"><1070></font> by 30% for 1.5s. Transformed heroes cannot attack or use skills.

skills.name: Molina Blitz
skills.description:
Nana summons <font color="a6aafb">Molina</font> to strike the target area 3 times, each dealing 440<font color="62f8fe"> (+140% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slowing enemies in the area by 30% for 1s.

Consecutive hits from <font color="a6aafb">Molina Blitz</font> on the same enemy stun them for 1s.

skills.name: Crimson Blood Banquet
skills.description:
Alice gains 1 stack(s) of <font color="a6aafb">Crimson</font> each time her skill hits an enemy, lasting 4s (up to 2 stacks). <font color="a6aafb">Blood Banquet</font> activates at max stacks.

<font color="a6aafb">Blood Banquet</font>: Every 0.5s, Alice deals 25<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 0.5% - 2.5% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>, scaling with level) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies. She also recovers 10<font color="26e407"> (+3% Extra Max HP)</font> HP and gains 8% Movement Speed. Its duration is refreshed when her skills hit an enemy hero.
Damage to creeps is capped at 70 (+10*Hero Level) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.

skills.name: Crimson Gleam
skills.description:
Alice shoots <font color="a6aafb">Blood Energy</font> forward, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Before <font color="a6aafb">Blood Energy</font> dissipates, Alice can recast this skill as <font color="a6aafb">Scarlet Shadow</font> to blink to its location.

skills.name: Doom Waltz
skills.description:
Alice performs a deadly dance, dealing 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+130% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1s.

If <font color="a6aafb">Blood Banquet</font> is active, the skill also scorches enemies, dealing 300% of <font color="a6aafb">Blood Banquet</font>'s damage and recovering the same amount of HP.

skills.name: Throne of Ruin
skills.description:
Alice surrounds herself with blood, gaining Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction while slowing herself by 50%.

After 1.5s, she descends from above, dealing 500<font color="62f8fe"> (+200% Total Magic Power)</font><font color="26e407"> (+20% Extra Max HP)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to all enemies in range and immobilizing them for 1s.

While charging her Ultimate, Alice cannot use any hero skills other than <font color="a6aafb">Scarlet Shadow</font>.

skills.name: Moon Blessing
skills.description:
Each time Miya's Basic Attack hits a target, she gains 5% Attack Speed for 4s (up to 5 stacks).

At maximum stacks, each Basic Attack also summons a <font color="a6aafb">Moonlight Shadow</font> to attack the target, dealing 25<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, inheriting 20% Attack Effects.

skills.name: Moon Arrow
skills.description:
Miya's Basic Attacks shoot 2 extra <font color="a6aafb">Split Arrows</font>, each inheriting 30% of Attack Effects. They deal 10<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the primary target and 30% damage to other targets.

This effect lasts 4s.

skills.name: Arrow of Eclipse
skills.description:
Miya calls upon the power of <font color="a6aafb">Moon Eclipse</font> in the target area, dealing 270<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

The attack then splits into 6 arrows that scatter in different directions. Each arrow deals 40<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slows enemies hit by 30% for 2s.

skills.name: Hidden Moonlight
skills.description:
Miya removes all debuffs and enters the <font color="a6aafb">Conceal</font> state, gaining 65% Movement Speed for up to 2s (attacking ends the state early).

Upon exiting the <font color="a6aafb">Conceal</font> state, Miya gains maximum stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Moon Blessing</font>.

skills.name: Bloodthirst
skills.description: Balmond recovers 5% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> upon killing a minion or creep, and 10% <font color="26e407"><1005></font> upon a hero kill or assist.

skills.name: Soul Lock
skills.description:
Balmond charges in the target direction, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way.
He stops upon hitting an enemy hero, knocking them back and slowing them by 40% for 3s.

skills.name: Cyclone Sweep
skills.description:
Balmond gains 15% Movement Speed and spins with his axe for 3s, dealing 30<font color="26e407"> (+1.3% Max HP)</font> <font color="fba51f"> (+25% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> per hit to nearby enemies up to 14 times.

Each hit reduces the target's <font color="fba51f"><1060></font> by 5% (up to 40%).

skills.name: Lethal Counter
skills.description:
Balmond unleashes a powerful strike in a target direction, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> (+ 30% of the target's <font color="26e407">lost <1997></font>) as <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font>. This skill can only be interrupted by <font color="a6aafb">Suppression</font>.

Damage dealt to non-hero units is capped at 1000 <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font>.

skills.name: Enemy's Bane
skills.description: Each time Saber deals damage, he reduces the target's <font color="fba51f"><1060></font> by 3-8 for 5s (up to 5 stacks).

skills.name: Orbiting Swords
skills.description:
Saber releases 5 swords that orbit around him and deal 75<font color="fba51f"> (+25% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies on hit. The swords will retract back to him after the duration.

While active, Sword attacks deal 200<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target and 50% damage to enemies along the path (damage reduced to 50% against minions). Each sword attack reduces the cooldowns of <font color="a6aafb">Orbiting Swords</font> by 0.5s and <font color="a6aafb">Charge</font> by 1s.

skills.name: Charge
skills.description:
Saber dashes in the target direction, dealing 75<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the path.

After the dash, he gains an <font color="a6aafb">Enhanced Basic Attack</font> that allows him to charge at the target, dealing 75<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slowing them by 60% for 1s.

skills.name: Triple Sweep
skills.description: Saber charges at the target enemy hero, knocking them airborne for 1.2s (unaffected by Resilience). He strikes them 3 times over the duration, dealing 120<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> with the first 2 strikes and 240<font color="fba51f"> (+160% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> with the third.
